jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Join us at ProcessOut

ProcessOut is a pioneer in the payment orchestration space. We are on a mission to help merchants build, scale and optimize their payment infrastructure. We work to bring simplicity, flexibility & performance to payments.

Millions of transactions are routed via ProcessOut everyday for merchants all over the world. We are proud to partner with amazing merchants like Glovo, Bolt, Sainsbury’s, Dott, Hellofresh and many more!

We were acquired by Checkout.com in 2020 with the goal of growing our global reach.

If you are looking to join a very fast-moving company with passionate, hard-working & fun teams, ProcessOut is for you! At ProcessOut, we are looking for people who are convinced they can play a central part in the Company's success! We are looking for people who are passionate, who are looking to achieve their full potential & who will actively contribute to strengthen the links between our teams. We value people that fully own their work and are passionate about building the next generation of online payments with us.


Project Management at ProcessOut

As a Mid-level Project Manager within our Integrations Team, you will sit at the heart of our merchants expansion. The team is dedicated to:

  1. Architecting payments framework that guarantee high velocity and uncompromising quality for new payment providers on-boarding.

  2. Integrating with a global network of payment providers.

In this high-impact role, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Own the planification of a team of 10+ engineers, which will involve collecting the needs from merchants

  • Orchestrating complex merchant timelines and delivery projects, championing excellence at every stage.

  • Cultivating and maintaining strategic partnerships with global payment providers (we have more than 100, but only few are strategical)

We operate as a self-sufficient, fully agile unit. To thrive here, you should:

  • Possess a deep understanding of both payment ecosystems and engineering principles.

    • You'll collaborate with Europe's leading merchants, work alongside world-class engineers and discuss with banks from all around the world

  • Masterfully navigate complex trade-offs and rapid context switching in a dynamic environment.

  • Drive external communication and engage directly, with often physical visits, with partners across Europe.

  • Being able to challenge other remits (engineering, product, merchants, providers) with data driven decisions

We are experiencing constant growth in the number of transactions handled, new clients, and integrations. That’s why we pay very close attention to efficiency and we are happy to improve our processes.


About you

  • At least 5 years of experience in payments

  • Know your way around web-related tech (HTTP, TLS, proxies, API conventions...)

  • Have a technical background and is able to understand software code

  • Able to communicate with third-party providers from both a technical perspective and business

  • Be product minded

  • Always curious and passionate about understanding the business

Nice to have

  • French language

  • Cards payments knowledge

What you will be doing

  • Working with engineers, merchants and payments providers to connect ProcessOut to worldwide acquirers and payment methods

  • Contributing to the business by computing KPIs and improving our processes in order to improve them

  • Own the product vision to help on designing, building, and releasing new features

If you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please apply anyway. We're always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.

Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. jobs.title: Commercial Lead - Clinical Trials
jobs.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We are hiring a Clinical Trials Lead to own the commercial work that follows. You will develop Heidi’s view of the market, identify the strongest entry point, build senior relationships across the industry, secure early customers and shape a repeatable route to market. Your knowledge of clinical trials will inform and shape what Heidi builds.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates like a founder. You will make the calls, open the doors, write the proposal, run the meeting and stay accountable after the contract is signed. As the business proves itself, the role can grow into broader ownership of Heidi’s clinical trials business.

What you’ll do

  • Develop the market thesis. Map the clinical trials ecosystem, test the most valuable opportunities and recommend where Heidi should focus its time and capital.

  • Lead customer development. Build direct relationships with senior decision makers across sponsors, biotechnology companies, CROs, sites and health systems. Conduct the outreach yourself and turn conversations into qualified opportunities.

  • Own early commercial outcomes. Build the pipeline, secure design partners and paid programmes, and own early revenue. Define the measures that show whether the business is gaining traction.

  • Shape the proposition. Turn buyer needs into a clear commercial offer, including target customer, value proposition, pricing, packaging and proof of value.

  • Inform what Heidi builds. Bring evidence from customers and clinical trials workflows to the product lead. Help the team choose problems worth solving while the product lead retains ownership of product strategy and delivery.

  • Navigate the buying process. Understand how life sciences organisations evaluate vendors, allocate budgets, manage procurement and compliance, and move from pilot to broader deployment.

  • Build the delivery model. Work with product, engineering, clinical, legal and implementation colleagues to make early programmes successful and increasingly repeatable.

  • Create the route to scale. Determine which partnerships, channels, proof points and team capabilities are required to grow beyond founder-led selling.

  • Represent Heidi. Build Heidi’s credibility with customers, partners and industry networks through thoughtful engagement and useful domain expertise.

What you’ll need

The strongest candidates will combine deep clinical trials knowledge with a record of creating commercial value. We expect the following experience.

  • Deep experience in the clinical trials industry through a pharmaceutical or biotechnology company, CRO, trial technology business, research network or closely related organisation.

  • A strong understanding of how clinical trials are funded, sold, bought and delivered, including the incentives and constraints faced by sponsors, CROs and research sites.

  • A record of building revenue, partnerships, a business line or a company in the sector. You can show what you personally originated and how it performed.

  • Senior commercial credibility. You can open a conversation with an industry executive, diagnose the underlying business problem and move the relationship towards a concrete commitment.

  • The judgement to operate in a regulated environment while respecting Good Clinical Practice, patient consent, privacy and data integrity.

  • The independence to create structure, make decisions and produce results without an established playbook or a large supporting team.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Head of Product - Cards - Amsterdam

Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

Cards is one of the most strategically important products at Mollie. It is the primary payment method operating at a global scale and the central enabler for Mollie to serve larger, more sophisticated merchants. As the accountable lead for online cards acceptance, you will own one of the highest net revenue-generating areas in the business, and your work will directly shape Mollie's ability to compete for and retain enterprise and mid-market merchants.

As the Head of Product for Cards Acquiring, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for one of the most critical payment methods. You will bridge the gap between heavy technical infrastructure and high-impact commercial enablement. Leading a cross-functional team of around 20 people that includes product delivery managers, a product partnership person, a dedicated data person, and a PMM, you will scale Mollie’s cards capabilities beyond Europe, unlock new merchant categories, and ensure our proposition wins the hearts of highly sophisticated merchants. You will also work directly with payment schemes and external partners, making decisions that influence both the product roadmap and Mollie's broader positioning in the market.

The cards domain is expected to become an increasingly primary driver of Mollie's growth over time, with the potential for the online and in-person card acceptance platforms to converge and expand the scope of this role significantly. If you want to own something that matters at a company that is moving fast in the right direction, this is it.

What you'll ship

  • End-to-end product ownership: own the full cards acceptance product lifecycle—from deep technical infrastructure and processing stability to commercial enablement.

  • Go-To-Market & commercial enablement: lead the GTM strategy for new card features in tight lockstep with Product Marketing (PMM) and Commercial teams. You'll translate complex technical capabilities into crystal-clear value propositions that our sales teams can run with.

  • Global scale: drive the geographic expansion of our cards product, building out capabilities beyond Europe to support Mollie’s international growth.

  • Portfolio optimisation: Identify untapped merchant vertical opportunities and make data-driven decisions to maximise net revenue across the entire cards portfolio.

  • Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing product team.

What You’ll Bring

  • Commercial & GTM Strategy: A proven track record of launching successful financial/payment products. You know how to price, position, and package features alongside PMM to win market share.

  • Partnership acumen: deep understanding of direct vs. indirect relationship strategies in the payments ecosystem and their respective commercial implications.

  • Technical depth: you aren't afraid of complexity. You can comfortably navigate the underlying technical architecture of cards acquiring, including the intricacies of the PCI compliance landscape.

  • Operational scale: experience managing operations-heavy environments and a proven ability to build scalable organisational structures that handle massive transaction volumes.

  • Customer obsession: this is non-negotiable at Mollie. You have a relentless drive to understand merchant pain points and build products that genuinely delight them.

  • Leadership: experience leading and developing cross-functional teams. You know how to cultivate a culture of high performance, accountability, and psychological safety.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

AI at Mollie

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Circularity Order Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About the team

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Circularity Order Lifecycle squad.

We're the team behind Back Market's Trade-in program, the system that lets customers exchange their old devices for cash toward their next refurbished purchase. It's a win-win-win: customers get more purchasing power, refurbishers get quality supply, and the planet gets a break from unnecessary e-waste.

To achieve this, our team is made up of seven engineers, an engineering manager and a product manager collaborating closely with designers, data analysts, operations and business partners.

Join us and help build the features that make it easier for customers and refurbishers to complete successful trade-in journeys.


As a Software Engineer, you will work closely with all members of your squad, and the Staff engineer of your group. Bi-monthly rituals with your group and the Chapter will allow you to share what works for your squad, learn what works for others, and make sure your technical direction is aligned with the overall vision.

What you will do in this role

We’re looking for versatile engineers who show strong ownership and are motivated to take on new challenges across the technical stack while helping us move our technology forward.

You will be working in an agile "build it and run it" environment where engineering teams build, launch, monitor and support the product that they own.

Driven by the desire to craft outstanding products, you understand how to deliver seamless user experiences at scale.

We are looking for passion in creating systems by producing clean, consistent and well-organized code.

As well as a good team player supporting colleagues and creating a learning and sharing environment!

English must be a no-brainer as you will join an international team dispatched in different locations around the world (US/FR/ES/JP).


Our technical environment

Backend stack: Python - FastAPI , SQLAlchemy, Celery, Golang, Django (being phased out)

Frontend stack: VueJS, Typescript, Nuxt, Revolve ( our design system)
Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, BigQuery
Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Datadog, ArgoCD, CircleCI, Github


Main technical challenges

Traditionally based on a monolith, Back Market's technical stack has been undergoing a radical transformation in recent years into a distributed and service-oriented architecture. This transition provides an opportunity to modernize the platform, raising engineering standards.
Building a set of efficient and loosely coupled services is one of the main challenges to face for the years to come. But teams are excited to independently control their release schedules, manage their data, SLAs, tools, and – ultimately – be responsible for their own service-offering. Meanwhile, Platform teams are working to provide a scalable, consistent and secure platform, one that makes engineering teams more productive.

As a Senior Engineer: Produce, Innovate & Share

  • Facilitates meaningful discussions around complex issues.

  • Suggests or makes improvements for existing designs and architecture for quarter-bounded projects or mission-critical areas in their squad.

  • Explores technologies with sizable potential impact for the team.

  • Is able to contribute actively to high impact chaos mitigation.

  • Identifies and advocate for prioritization of tasks that can optimize delivery

    Required Skills and Experience

    • 5+ years of backend engineering experience with strong proficiency in Go (primary requirement) and proven experience with Python

    • Solid understanding of microservices architecture, with experience building and maintaining high-traffic backend services and regular feature delivery

    • Working knowledge of modern web frontend technologies (Vue.js, React, or similar) with comfort in JavaScript/TypeScript for full-stack contribution

    • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality, non-disruptive production releases with strong SDLC knowledge and comprehensive testing experience

    • Experience building observability systems (monitoring, alerting, tracing) and using data to drive improvements, with incident management and on-call experience

    • Strong knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL, Redis) and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ), with expertise in API design (REST, GraphQL)

    • Demonstrated pragmatism in technical decision-making, able to challenge approaches diplomatically and question task legitimacy when appropriate

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences in cross-functional teams

    • Proven ability to work autonomously within squad scope, managing deliverables while contributing to team knowledge through documentation and code reviews

Recruitment process

  • Call with a Senior Tech TA, 45 min

  • Coding and Testing module, 60 min

  • System design Feature interview, 45 min

  • Data module, 45 min

  • Technical Leadership, 45 min

  • Meet your manager, 30 min

  • Back Market Values fit interview - 45 min

Hybrid policy - Paris office

3 days /week at the office - Monday is mandatory

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

Drie uitdagingen die jij natuurlijk graag aangaat. Het is dan ook jouw aard om altijd een beetje meer te geven dan de klant en je collega’s verwachten.

Taken

In deze super veelzijdige functie ben jij niet alleen het al-ziend-oog met betrekking tot het implementeren van hun software, maar denk jij ook mee met de software ontwikkeling en wensen van de klant. Jouw eigenschap dat je goed overzicht kan houden is handig, want je hebt meestal meerdere projecten tegelijk. Als de situatie daar om vraagt, ben jij in staat om een maatwerkaanpak voor jouw project te bedenken. Jij weet als geen ander het overzicht te behouden, prioriteiten te stellen en de klant tevreden te stellen met hun nieuwe oplossing. Nog niet genoeg uitdaging? We zijn ons internationaal aan het plaatsen, dus wie weet ga je ook in andere landen aan de slag.

Uiteraard ben je communicatief een kei. Je weet andere te inspireren en ben je in staat om de consultants en keyusers topprestaties te laten leveren (niet dat ze dat nog niet doen). jobs.title: Cloud Engineer (H/F/N) - CDI - Paris
jobs.description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne.

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation.

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.

Votre mission  

Au sein de l'équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development), la team Platform Engineering conçoit et opère les infrastructures, les outillages et les services socles qui permettent à nos produits Data & IA de fonctionner de façon fiable, scalable et sécurisée. 

Au carrefour du Cloud Engineering, du DevOps, de la sécurité et de l'expérience développeur, vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de nos applications : de la conception des infrastructures à leur exploitation en production, en passant par l'automatisation, la supervision et l'amélioration continue. 

Nous recherchons un·e Devops senior pour prendre un rôle moteur dans l'évolution de notre plateforme. Vous apporterez votre expertise pour concevoir des architectures robustes, définir les standards techniques et accompagner la montée en compétence de l'équipe.

Votre rôle dans l'équipe 

Expert·e en Cloud Engineering, vous deviendrez un·e référent·e technique au sein de l'équipe Platform Engineering. Vous piloterez des chantiers d'architecture, proposerez des évolutions structurantes, garantirez la fiabilité et la scalabilité de nos environnements, et contribuerez activement à la culture technique de l'équipe. 

Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering 

  • Concevoir et piloter l'évolution des architectures cloud (Azure, GCP, AWS) : choix techniques, patterns d'infrastructure, gouvernance. 

  • Définir et maintenir les standards infrastructure-as-code avec Terraform, et impulser les bonnes pratiques au sein de l'équipe. 

  • Piloter l'évolution des briques data et applicatives en garantissant leur disponibilité, leur performance et leur scalabilité. 

Automatisation 

  • Définir et faire évoluer l'architecture CI/CD de la plateforme : standards, patterns de déploiement, stratégies GitOps. 

  • Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation à fort impact et les piloter de bout en bout. 

  • Challenger et améliorer en continu les pratiques d'infrastructure-as-code, de release management et de delivery. 

  • Contribuer à la définition de la roadmap technique plateforme avec le Lead Platform Engineer. 

 Fiabilité, Sécurité & Observabilité 

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie IAM de la plateforme : modélisation RBAC, politiques d'accès, principe de least privilege, gouvernance des identités et des secrets (Vault ou équivalent). 

  • Concevoir et opérer la couche de fédération d'identité : Keycloak, protocoles OIDC/OAuth2/SAML, intégration avec les environnements cloud (Azure Entra ID, GCP IAM).

  • Piloter la gestion des incidents majeurs, animer les post-mortems et structurer les plans de remédiation. 

  • Concevoir et maintenir une posture sécurité robuste, en lien avec les équipes internes dédiées. 

 Collaboration & Developer Experience 

  • Animer la culture Platform Engineering au sein de l'équipe : revues techniques, partages de pratiques, mentorat. 

 

Notre méthode de travail 

 Les produits sont conçus et développés depuis nos bureaux, ce qui nous permet de vraiment travailler ensemble dans la durée et de partager nos pratiques. Le télétravail reste toujours possible, bien qu'il soit plus sympa d'avoir la team réunie ! 

Nous travaillons en cycles agiles, avec des phases de discovery (compréhension des besoins, des contraintes et des architectures cibles) et de delivery (réalisation, déploiement, amélioration continue). La Platform Engineering est impliquée tout au long de ce processus, de la conception des solutions à leur exploitation en production. 

Sous la responsabilité d'un·e Lead Platform Engineer et intégré·e dans une équipe plateforme de 7 personnes où règnent la bonne humeur et la bienveillance, vous serez à l'avant-poste du futur technologique chez Ekimetrics.

Notre stack technique 

Vous retrouverez un écosystème riche et en perpétuelle évolution, nous sommes toujours ouverts aux suggestions et aux propositions ! 

Cloud & Infrastructure : 

  • GCP, Azure, AWS, Databricks, DataFactory — Kubernetes, Docker, ArgoCD, Helm, Nginx, Terraform 

Data & Applications : 

  • PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Spark, Redis — Python, FastAPI, RabbitMQ, Airbyte 

 Observabilité & Sécurité : 

  • New Relic, Keycloak, Cloudflare 

Outils transverses : 

  • GitHub, JIRA, Figma 

Votre profil 

Vous êtes diplômé·e d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'un diplôme universitaire équivalent, ou avez une expérience significative qui fait foi. 

  • Vous avez 3 ans ou plus d'expérience en Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, dont une partie significative en contexte de production à grande échelle. 

  • Vous maîtrisez Terraform et imposez naturellement les bonnes pratiques d'infrastructure-as-code dans votre équipe. 

  • Vous avez une expertise avérée sur Azure et une maîtrise opérationnelle d'au moins un autre cloud (GCP ou AWS). 

  • Vous avez une expérience significative en conception et opération d'une couche IAM en production : fédération d'identité (Keycloak ou équivalent), protocoles OIDC, OAuth2 et SAML, intégration multi-environnements. 

  • Vous maîtrisez les pratiques de sécurité cloud : gestion des secrets (Vault ou équivalent), politiques IAM cloud (Azure Entra ID, GCP IAM), RBAC Kubernetes et segmentation réseau. 

  • Vous êtes autonome, orienté·e impact, à l'aise dans un environnement multi-projets et international. 

  • Vous avez un bon niveau de français et d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. 

 Nice to have : 

  • Une expérience en multi-cloud (Azure + GCP ou AWS) dans un contexte de production. 

  • Une expérience dans la conception ou l'animation d'une Internal Developer Platform (Backstage). 

  • Vous maîtrisez Kubernetes en profondeur : architecture, sécurisation, optimisation des ressources, multi-tenancy, opération en production. 

  • Une expérience dans la mise en place de pratiques d'ingénierie de fiabilité (observabilité avancée, incident management, chaos engineering). 

  • Une expérience avec des outils de GenAI pour automatiser des workflows ou interagir avec d'autres plateformes via des MCPs. 

  • Une expérience dans un environnement SaaS B2B ou scale-up tech à forte croissance. 

  • Une certification en sécurité cloud ou IAM (Azure Security Engineer Associate, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist – CKS, ou équivalent). 

  • Une connaissance autour de produits Databricks. 

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  

Vous aurez accès :

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ;
  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;
  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards)
  • Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
Notre processus de recrutement : 
  • Un entretien RH & culture fit avec l'équipe Talent Acquisition
  • Un entretien technique avec des membres de l'équipe Platform : Julien & François – Platform Engineers
  • Un entretien Case-study avec Cedric – Lead Platform Engineer
  • Un entretien final avec Jérôme – Associate Engineering Director 

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst
jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to establish our product analytics function and bring deep analytical rigor to product decision-making. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design on product planning, designing A/B tests, and creating analytics frameworks that enable data-driven product development.

Compensation: 90-110k

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

About the Role

  • Conduct deep-dive analysis of feature success, retention drivers, and long-term engagement patterns to generate actionable product insights and inform roadmap decisions

  • Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Design on product planning, bringing a data lens to ideation and concept evaluation throughout the product development lifecycle

  • Design and structure A/B tests to ensure statistical rigor, including experiment design, sample size calculations, and analysis of results using cohort analysis and causal inference methods

  • Create analytics frameworks and event taxonomy to maintain data quality, partnering with the data platform team to keep data sources clean and well-defined

  • Enable Product Manager self-service through tooling, documentation, and light-touch support, using AI tools and MCP integrations to turbocharge analyses and scale impact

About You

  • 5-10 years experience in product analytics or data science with deep familiarity with A/B testing, experiment design, and cohort analysis within platforms such as Mixpanel or Amplitude (mobile app experience is a plus)

  • Proven ability to apply behavioral and statistical analysis methods such as behavioral clustering, propensity score matching, and regression modeling to deliver actionable product insights

  • Fluent in SQL and Python with strong technical skills for data manipulation, analysis, and visualization

  • Strong product sense with ability to generate product and behavioral hypotheses from data insights and experiment results, translating business questions into structured analytical approaches

  • Excellent communication skills, able to communicate clearly around data insights, limitations, and approaches to technical and non-technical audiences, comfortable using AI tools to enhance analytical output

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.


Benefits

  • 30 days annual leave plus local public holidays

  • Competitive equity package with stock options/BSPCE, giving you ownership in our growing company

  • €1000 one-time home office grant OR €400 per month co-working space stipend

  • €1,000 annual learning and development budget for training, courses, books, and skill development

  • Private health insurance

  • Access to personalised mental health support, including 1:1 sessions with therapists or coaches, self-care tools, and well-being resources via MokaCare

  • Sports and cultural activities reimbursement

  • Relocation support (up to 10k) available for those choosing to move to France, including apartment finding and visa assistance

Note: Visa sponsorship and relocation support are only available for positions based in France. We cannot sponsor visas for remote positions outside of France.


Hiring Process

  1. Screening call with Talent Manager (30min)

  2. Technical interview with Hiring Manager (1 hr)

  3. Take-home assignment (duration varies by role) and live review with the team (1 hr)

  4. Culture fit interviews and meet the team (~3h in total)

  5. Reference check and offer


Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (French-speaking) - Airline or Airline Catering 80-100% (Europe, 100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join our fully remote, mission-driven team dedicated to pioneering sustainable inflight service management. Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.

Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our team.

In this role, you will own a portfolio of airline customers and be responsible for driving long-term customer success, retention, and growth. You will act as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders, ensuring that customers realise measurable value from LimeFlight while continuously identifying opportunities to expand their usage.

This is not a purely operational role you will take ownership of customer outcomes and proactively manage relationships.

Fluency in French is a strong plus to support our international customer base.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Customer Ownership

  • Own and manage a portfolio of key airline customers

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders across operations, IT, and management

  • Act as a strategic partner, aligning LimeFlight capabilities with customer business objectives

  • Lead regular business reviews and management meetings

Customer Value & Growth

  • Monitor customer health, adoption, and satisfaction

  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities (e.g. modules, integrations, services)

  • Drive retention and expansion revenue within your customer portfolio

  • Actively contribute to renewal processes and commercial discussions

Implementation Oversight

  • Support onboarding and implementation phases as a strategic counterpart

  • Guide customers through integrations, data setup, and adoption best practices

  • Collaborate with implementation teams to ensure a smooth transition into run mode

Training & Enablement

  • Deliver targeted training sessions and workshops (remote & on-site)

  • Enable customers to adopt new features and optimize their processes

  • Promote best practices and continuous improvement

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with various teams

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally

  • Provide structured feedback to influence product development

Key competencies

  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in the Airline Industry or Airline Catering Industry

  • Experience working with SaaS products or complex B2B software solutions is a plus

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

  • Ability to manage multiple customer relationships in a fast-paced environment

  • Commercial mindset with a focus on value creation and growth

  • Proactive, ownership-driven approach to customer success

  • Highly organised and reliable

Language

  • Fluent in English & French

Expected Travel Needs

You should be willing to travel up to 20% a year to customer on-site visits.

Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen (45 mins)

  2. Interview with Hiring Manager (1 hour)

  3. Technical Interview (30 mins)

  4. Discussion with founder(s) and peer(s)


LimeFlight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work.

Join us and be part of a team committed to shaping a zero-waste future for aviation, where your ideas and passion truly matter.

Let’s talk!

jobs.title: Product Designer- Cloud
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for digital innovation and transformation. Our portfolio includes product lifecycle management, electronic design automation, low-code application development, and enterprise software solutions that help companies accelerate innovation and create lasting value. At Mendix, we empower organizations to build, deploy, and govern modern applications using our low-code platform. With the resources of a large company and the innovation of a software leader, we create solutions that enable our customers to achieve more.

Position Overview

Join the Cloud Unit within Mendix R&D, helping customers deploy, operate, and govern applications and platform environments. We make complex cloud capabilities, administration, and integrations easier to use. You'll help shape a new agentic platform, working with product managers, technical leads, and developers to frame problems, validate ideas, and deliver well-crafted experiences, including interactions between people and AI agents. AI is central to what we build and how we work. We value strong UX and UI craft through clear thinking, communication, rapid prototyping, and attention to the implemented experience, not just polished design files.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Work with product and technical teams to discover and frame problems, challenge assumptions, and explore opportunities.
  • Create concepts and functional prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools to explore behaviours, test assumptions, and support product decisions.
  • Conduct concept-validation sessions and usability tests with Research Ops support. Test user understanding, task success, and recovery when things go wrong, and use findings to improve designs.
  • Deliver detailed UI and interaction designs, including how people guide, review, and correct AI agents. Apply existing design-system patterns and contribute improvements where needed.
  • Work closely with developers through implementation and conduct design QA to improve usability and experience quality.
  • Communicate decisions clearly, share work in progress, and own defined problems with guidance while collaborating on more complex challenges.

    • Qualifications:
  • Around 2–5 years of relevant product design experience and a design degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong UX, interaction, and UI design skills, with experience using design systems.
  • Hands-on experience using AI in research and design workflows and building functional prototypes with AI-assisted coding tools.
  • Experience validating concepts, testing usability, and collaborating with product managers and developers.
  • Initiative, comfort with ambiguity, and willingness to challenge assumptions and learn from feedback.
  • Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to articulate ideas and explain design decisions.

    • Preferred Skills:
  • Experience designing AI-powered or human–agent experiences.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, cloud platforms, deployment, operations, or governance.

    • Why Us

    We are Siemens:
    At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.
    You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

    Our Benefits & Rewards

    The salary range for this position is €60,000- €75,000 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

    Diversity & Inclusion

    We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can bring their authentic self to work. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experiences. We believe in building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Siemens is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

    How We Work

    You'll join a design team working across multiple product and development teams. We use Figma and AI-assisted tools, but specific tools are not a checklist. Functional prototyping is expected; production coding is not. Hybrid arrangements are agreed within the team.

    Your Portfolio

    Show how you think, collaborate, and learn, from problem framing to testing and delivery. Include work-in-progress artefacts, prototypes, and how findings changed your designs. Explain your contribution, trade-offs, and outcomes where available. We value an honest view of your process over a polished sales presentation.

     

    #LI-Hybrid #LI-SaaS

    Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday.

jobs.title: Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

jobs.title: Medior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Software Engineer die graag zelfstandig bouwt aan slimme, schaalbare software? Wil je technische uitdagingen oplossen, meedenken over nieuwe functionaliteiten en jezelf blijven ontwikkelen binnen een ervaren productteam? Dan is deze functie bij BAS World iets voor jou!

Bij BAS World ontwikkelen we digitale producten waarmee klanten wereldwijd trucks, trailers, machines en onderdelen kunnen kopen en verkopen. Onze software ondersteunt internationale handelsprocessen en wordt dagelijks gebruikt door klanten en collega's over de hele wereld.

Als Medior Software Engineer werk je binnen een van onze productteams aan betrouwbare en schaalbare software. Je pakt zelfstandig technische vraagstukken op, denkt mee over de beste oplossingen en bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van het begrijpen van het probleem tot het bouwen, testen en onderhouden van de oplossing.

Je werkt nauw samen met andere Engineers, Product Owners en collega's vanuit de business. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om technische keuzes te maken, nieuwe ideeën aan te dragen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior Software Engineer werk je aan digitale producten die direct bijdragen aan de groei van BAS World. Je schrijft niet alleen code, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we onze software en processen kunnen verbeteren.

Je werkt binnen een van onze vijf productpijlers: Operations, Parts & Tyres, Buyer, Seller of Platform Engineering. Samen met jouw team ontwikkel je oplossingen die waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten en collega's.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt schaalbare en betrouwbare software;

  • Je pakt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische vraagstukken op, van analyse tot implementatie en beheer;

  • Je werkt samen met Product Owners, Engineers en collega's vanuit de business om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar technische oplossingen;

  • Je denkt mee tijdens de discoveryfase, onderzoekt verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en test ideeën waar nodig met prototypes;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code en draagt bij aan de kwaliteit, beveiliging en betrouwbaarheid van onze software;

  • Je voert code reviews uit, werkt samen via pair programming en deelt actief kennis met collega's;

  • Je onderzoekt en verhelpt incidenten en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen;

  • Je signaleert technische verbeterkansen en experimenteert met nieuwe technologieën en moderne engineeringtools.

Je krijgt de vrijheid om zelfstandig aan oplossingen te werken, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. Je leert van ervaren collega's, deelt jouw eigen kennis en werkt samen aan producten die dagelijks wereldwijd worden gebruikt.

Wat maakt deze functie zo interessant?

Bij BAS World werk je niet alleen aan technische oplossingen, maar denk je ook mee over de ontwikkeling van onze digitale producten. Je krijgt de ruimte om kritische vragen te stellen, ideeën te testen en invloed uit te oefenen op technische keuzes.

Je werkt in een productgedreven organisatie waar we continu zoeken naar manieren om onze software slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken.

Of je nu nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwikkelt, bestaande systemen verbetert of experimenteert met AI en cloud-native technologie: je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf technisch verder te ontwikkelen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris dat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen een ervaren productteam;

  • De mogelijkheid om te werken aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt;

  • Volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen via interne en externe opleidingen;

  • De vrijheid om te experimenteren met AI, cloud-native technologie en moderne engineeringtools;

  • Directe samenwerking met ervaren Engineers, Product Owners en andere technische specialisten;

  • De keuze tussen een MacBook of Windows-laptop;

  • Een informele, internationale werkomgeving met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.


Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een Software Engineer die zelfstandig kan werken, graag technische uitdagingen aangaat en verder kijkt dan alleen het schrijven van code.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt ervaring als Software Engineer en kunt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische oplossingen ontwikkelen;

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk, van het ontwerp tot een betrouwbare werking in productie;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code;

  • Je denkt mee over technische keuzes en weet jouw ideeën en oplossingen duidelijk uit te leggen;

  • Je werkt graag samen met collega's, staat open voor feedback en deelt actief jouw kennis;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en denkt graag mee over verbeteringen;

  • Je werkt minimaal vier dagen per week vanuit ons kantoor in Veghel, zodat je nauw kunt samenwerken met jouw team.

Daarnaast heb je ervaring met meerdere van de volgende technologieën en werkwijzen:

  • PHP, Laravel en/of andere moderne frontend- en backendtechnologieën;

  • Cloud-native softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur binnen AWS;

  • API's, data-uitwisseling en gedistribueerde systemen;

  • CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen en databases;

  • Softwarearchitectuur, observability, security en schaalbaarheid.

Je hoeft niet overal expert in te zijn. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je een goede technische basis hebt, zelfstandig kunt werken en gemotiveerd bent om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Interesse?

Wil jij bouwen aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt en jezelf verder ontwikkelen als Software Engineer? Solliciteer dan direct en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden bij BAS World!

Wij zijn BAS!

BAS is een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive-sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel en het onderhoud van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

jobs.title: Technical Support Consultant
jobs.description:
Print & Copy Channel Business Unit

Locatie:

Deze hybride functie biedt de flexibiliteit om zowel vanuit ons kantoor in Almere als vanuit huis te werken.

Contract:

Het betreft een functie voor onbepaalde tijd, onder voorbehoud van de toepasselijke lokale arbeidswetgeving op basis van de standplaats van de kandidaat.

Rapporteert aan:

Cluster Manager (Primair & Commercieel) en IT Manager (Technisch & functioneel)

Scope:

Ondersteuning voor Single cluster (BnNe-regio)

Over ITS

Info Technology Supply Ltd (ITS) is een gerenommeerd softwarebedrijf met meer dan 38 jaar ervaring in de print- en documentmanagementindustrie in Europa en Noord- en Zuid-Amerika. Onze Business Unit Print & Copy Channel distribueert exclusief softwareoplossingen van toonaangevende leveranciers en ondersteunt een uitgebreid netwerk van meer dan 2.000 resellers en partners, verdeeld over zes regionale clusters.

Als het grootste PaperCut Authorised Solution Centre van Europa beschikken wij over een uitgebreid portfolio, waaronder PaperCut MF, NG, Hive en Pocket, evenals Umango, Willow360 en DocSlide. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij diverse aanvullende modules die onze oplossingen verder versterken en uitbreiden.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Tegelijkertijd behouden wij de persoonlijke betrokkenheid, korte lijnen en warme familiecultuur die ons al jarenlang kenmerken.

De Kans

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om je technische expertise verder te ontwikkelen en onderdeel te worden van het Technical Services Team van een internationaal en innovatief softwarebedrijf.

Als Technical Support Consultant ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van technische ondersteuning en het uitvoeren van implementaties bij klanten binnen de BeNe-regio. Je werkt hybride vanuit ons kantoor in Almere, gecombineerd met thuiswerken.

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een enthousiaste en nauwkeurige professional met een proactieve instelling en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Je bent in staat om klanten hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning te bieden en hen te begeleiden bij de implementatie en het beheer van onze oplossingen voor print-, scan- en documentmanagement.

Je werkt hierbij onder andere met producten uit ons portfolio, waaronder PaperCut, Umango, DocSlide en diverse andere innovatieve softwareoplossingen.

Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Customer Support (Klantenondersteuning)

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

2. Het installeren en configureren van softwareoplossingen zoals PaperCut MF en Hive, Umango en DocSlide.

3. Het analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken.

4. Het testen en reproduceren van klantproblemen in een virtuele omgeving.

Pre-Sales & Training

  1. Het geven van technische trainingen, workshops en online technische demonstraties.
  2. Het ondersteunen van collega's en bijdragen aan interne IT-projecten.
  3. Het beantwoorden van technische vragen van klanten en partners.
  4. Het samenwerken met support- en consultancycollega's binnen Europa.
  5. Het bezoeken van eindklanten in de BeNe-regio om installaties en trainingen ter plaatse uit te voeren.
  6. Nauwe samenwerking met het Internationale iTS Supportteam.
  7. Technische en functionele interne Presales-vragen beantwoorden.
  8. Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.


Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

  1. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  2. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.
  3. Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.


4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.


Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Your Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them.

 

What will keep you challenged?

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

  • Develop and manage ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

  • Implement and enforce data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

  • Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure


What you bring

  • Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar data related role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling principles to meet data governance, security, and compliance best practices and ensure safe and scalable data operations

  • FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

  • Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development and integrating them into standard workflows (code review, CI/CD), with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it.

  • Experience with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production.

  • Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus


What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.


What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Interview with Head of Data: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members: A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO.


About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

 

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.
