Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. More than 75% of Talk360's users are on Android. Every release you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people across more than 190 countries - migrants calling home, travellers managing emergencies, families staying connected across borders. For these users, a dropped call or a crash isn't a UX inconvenience. It's a broken connection to someone who matters. 
 

The craft challenge here is real. Our users are often on older devices, limited data plans, and unreliable networks. Building an app that performs beautifully under those conditions requires engineering excellence, not shortcuts. We're entering a new phase of growth. Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and mobile remains one of the most important products in the company. 
 

We’re looking for a Senior Android Engineer to join our mobile team. You’ll be a core contributor to app millions rely on, building features end-to-end, raising the bar on quality and performance, and working directly with Product and the business to understand our customers. You’ll work in a team where your impact is visible from day one, and where engineers who can reach across platforms are especially valued.

  • Help evolve our embedded calling SDK, used by partners to bring Talk360 calling into their own apps 

  • Shape our design system and help modernize the app as we move to a shared Kotlin Multiplatform codebase 

  • Own platform quality: releases, rollouts and app health

Who You Are

  • You enjoy solving hard technical problems while thinking about the bigger picture. 

  • You care deeply about software craftsmanship and user experience. 

  • You can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices 

  • You enjoy partnering with product teams and learning directly from customer feedback. 

  • You share what you know and help others improve and become stronger. 

  • You're pragmatic. You know when perfection matters and when shipping matters more. 

  • You're excited about building software that genuinely changes people's lives. 

  • You're based in or around Amsterdam and able to come to our office two to three times a week 

What You Get  

Competitive compensation

Learning and growth

From accessibility and SEO/AIO to analytics and content intelligence, our Agentic Content Intelligence Platform enables organizations to create, govern, and optimize digital content that is compliant, discoverable, and effective at scale.

We are seeking a high-performing Account Executive to join our EMEA Enterprise Sales team, covering the DACH region. In this quota-carrying role, you will drive new business growth across strategic enterprise accounts, partnering with organizations typically ranging from 250M–5B+ in revenue.

You will engage senior stakeholders across Marketing, Digital, Communications, IT, Accessibility, and Procurement to uncover business challenges and deliver measurable outcomes through Siteimprove’s SaaS and AI-powered platform. A strong command of German is required, as you will be working closely with customers and prospects across the DACH region. This is a high-impact role within a fast-growing international organization, offering the opportunity to shape how leading enterprises approach accessibility, content performance, and AI-driven digital governance.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - AI/ML - AI Platform
Brand Event Manager
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Alan is looking for a Global Brand Event Manager to turn events into a distinctive, scalable expression of the Alan brand. The role combines event strategy, brand experience, operational excellence, commercial understanding, and community building.

You will own Alan’s yearly flagship event, building on the success of Alan 10, and help make it an even stronger moment for brand, community, customers, prospects, partners, and the wider healthcare ecosystem. Beyond the flagship event, you will build the operating system that enables commercial and local teams to run high-quality events repeatedly and consistently.

It is a senior individual-contributor role that owns the global event system and makes other teams more autonomous and effective.

You will lead the global strategy and execution of Alan’s major Brand events, while owning the execution of local Brand events in France. You will create the playbooks, standards, templates, and measurement frameworks that allow teams across markets to deliver high-quality events without reinventing the wheel each time.

You will also contribute to the Brand team’s global community-event strategy, identifying the formats and moments that can make Alan more visible, credible, and memorable to the communities we want to influence.

You’ll equip local teams with the right local approach and assets, and support them as they adapt and run events in their markets.

Main responsibilities

  1. Own Alan’s yearly flagship event

    • Participate in the definition of the event’s purpose, audience, positioning, narrative, and success criteria.

    • Build the event roadmap, budget, and production plan.

    • Manage agencies, venues, suppliers, speakers, partners, and internal stakeholders.

    • Coordinate content, creative, production, guest management, press, influencers, Sales, and local market teams.

    • Design a high-quality guest experience before, during, and after the event.

    • Connect invitations, registration, CRM tracking, attendance, and follow-up.

    • Run rehearsals, speaker preparation, run-of-show management, and on-site execution.

  2. Build Alan’s recurring event playbook

    • Define the main event formats and their intended purposes, such as owned events, executive dinners, round tables, speaking opportunities, trade shows, and partner events.

    • Create practical templates for briefs, timelines, budgets, approvals, execution, production, and follow-up.

    • Help define the role of commercial teams before, during, and after the event.

    • Create reusable content, event assets, checklists, and quality standards.

  3. Support local teams on local events

    • Help local teams choose the right format and define the desired outcome.

    • Review briefs and plans, provide feedback, and raise the quality bar.

    • Identify successful local formats that could be scaled globally.

  4. Help shape and execute Alan’s community-event strategy

    • Contribute with the Brand team to the Community building strategy

    • Design recurring event franchises and formats.

    • Build partnerships with relevant organizations, experts, customers, and opinion leaders.

    • Run test-and-learn initiatives that can start locally and scale globally.

Profile & Competencies

We are looking for someone who has:

  • At least 5 years of experience delivering events end to end, ideally in a Brand, B2B marketing or agency environment.

  • A track record of creating original event concepts and formats, not only executing a brief.

  • Strong editorial judgement: the right angle, speakers and content to make an event memorable.

  • Brand creativity: a clear point of view on how an event expresses a brand.

  • Experience running complex events with multiple stakeholders, agencies, suppliers and speakers (including profiles with special logistics and security needs).

  • Strong production skills: planning, budgeting, vendor and risk management, rehearsals and on-site delivery.

  • Experience building repeatable processes, playbooks or templates.

  • A strong understanding of how events drive brand, community and commercial outcomes, and comfort with CRM, registration, lead capture and follow-up.

  • Experience working with Sales, Marketing, PR, Creative and local market teams.

  • Fluent in French

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, and willing to travel across international markets.

 

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

jobs.title: Account Executive (m/w/d) Legal Tech – DACH
jobs.description:
Where Legal Leads. 

Drei Worte. Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. 

DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. 

Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. 

Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? 


Deine Rolle 
 

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. 

  • Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. 

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. 

  • Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. 

  • Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. 

  • Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. 


Must-have

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. 

  • Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. 

  • Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. 

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. 

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. 


Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. 

  • Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. 

  • Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. 

  • Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext  und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. 


Was wir dir bieten

  • Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. 

  • Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. 

  • Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. 

  • Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. 

  • Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! 


Dein Weg zu uns

  1. Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. 

  1. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. 

  1. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. 

  1. Kurzes Rollenspiel (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit. 

Bist du bereit, bei uns einzusteigen?

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung.

Hinweis: Wir nutzen KI-gestützte Tools zur Vorauswahl von Bewerbungen. Die endgültige Entscheidung trifft immer ein Mensch.

jobs.title: Ausbildung zum*r Fachinformatiker*in Anwendungsentwicklung in der Spieleentwicklung 2027
jobs.description:
Programmieren ist Deine Leidenschaft, die Du zu Deinem Beruf machen möchtest? Du willst hautnah bei der Spieleentwicklung dabei sein? Lerne bei uns verschiedene Programmiersprachen, Tools und Teams in einem spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Umfeld kennen und verbessere stetig Deine Fähigkeiten. Im Rahmen der Ausbildung erlernst Du das Handwerkszeug für Deine professionelle Zukunft im Bereich Software Development. Du wirst während der Ausbildung in verschiedenen Entwicklungsteams arbeiten und dabei aktuelle Technologien und agile Arbeitsweisen erlernen und das Spielerlebnis von Millionen von Spielenden positiv beeinflussen.
 
Unsere Ausbildung findet in Hamburg statt. Profitiere von unserer starken Career Starter Gemeinschaft und dem direkten Austausch mit deinen Mentor*innen vor Ort in unserem Büro in Hamburg-Hammerbrook. Gleichzeitig kannst du dich über die Vorteile des hybriden Arbeitens freuen.
 
Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Bewirb Dich jetzt für den Ausbildungsbeginn im August 2027. Wir bieten Dir aktive Unterstützung durch ein engagiertes Team sowie modernste Arbeitsbedingungen in einem von Deutschlands erfolgreichsten Entwickler und Publisher von Online Games.

Dein Skillset
  • Klasse Leistung. Du wirst Dein Abitur oder Deine Fachhochschulreife mit guten Noten absolvieren.
  • Programmieren. Du bringst Vorkenntnisse in einer objektorientierten Skript- oder Programmiersprache mit (z.B. Java, C# oder PHP).
  • Spaß. Du hast Spaß an der Mathematik und den Naturwissenschaften.
  • Erste Praxis. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem kleineren Software-Projekt gemeinsam mit anderen gearbeitet.
  • Zukunftsgestalter*in. Du siehst in der Künstlichen Intelligenz die Chance, die Zukunft unserer Spiele mitzugestalten und freust dich, Deine Begeisterung und ersten KI-Erfahrungen in realen Projekten anzuwenden.
  • Eigenverantwortung. Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich und zeigst hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, Teamfähigkeit und Flexibilität.
  • Deutschkenntnisse. Für eine erfolgreiche Teilnahme an unserem Ausbildungsprogramm verfügst Du mindestens über ein B2-Niveau in Deutsch, da der Berufsschulunterricht ausschließlich in deutscher Sprache stattfindet.
  • Unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. Du freust Dich darauf im Betrieb Deine sehr guten Englischkenntnisse täglich in Wort und Schrift anzuwenden.
  • Gaming. Idealerweise hast Du eine Affinität für (Online) Games.

    • Deine Power-Ups
  • Ein Team von Spezialist*innen. Werde Teil eines großartigen, internationalen Teams von Spezialist*innen und arbeite und lerne bei einem der führenden Spieleentwickler und Publisher in Deutschland.
  • Optimales Lernumfeld. Wir bieten dir ein äußerst interessantes technisches Umfeld und modernste Arbeitsbedingungen.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FluxCD, Envoy Gateway, Karpenter, kro, KCL or Kubernetes operators

  • Migrating a monolith from VMs to Kubernetes

  • Managed databases and search in production (MySQL/PlanetScale, PostgreSQL, MongoDB Atlas, Elasticsearch)

  • A background in security, compliance (e.g. GDPR) or incident response

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo. It is part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

 

What’s in it for you?

We believe in supporting you to perform at your best and grow with us:

  • 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment.

  • 🌍 Hybrid working + 60 days per year to work abroad.

  • 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp).

  • 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel

  • 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected.

  • 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office.

  • 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future.

We aim to keep the process clear, fair, and timely, and we’ll keep you informed at every step.

 

Join us in building the future of customer engagement — we’d love to have you on the team.

jobs.description:
Über thexton armstrong

"Wir glauben: Nicht jeder Unternehmer ist ein geborener Entrepreneur. Aber jeder Unternehmer kann einer werden – mit der richtigen Begleitung."

thexton armstrong wurde 2011 in den Niederlanden gegründet mit einer klaren Mission: KMU-Inhabern die Unterstützung geben, die sie wirklich brauchen – nicht als externe Berater, die Präsentationen liefern, sondern als Vertrauenspersonen, die langfristig an ihrer Seite bleiben.

Heute ist das Netzwerk in 5 Ländern aktiv, zählt über 100 Partner und hat Hunderte von KMU geholfen, profitabler, stabiler und besser managebar zu werden. In Deutschland startete das Franchise Ende 2024 – jetzt kommt Nord- und Ostdeutschland.

Als thexton armstrong Partner in Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen, Leipzig, Dresden oder einer der anderen Metropolregionen der Region arbeiten Sie mit einem bewährten System, einer anerkannten Marke und einem Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Profis – europaweit.

Das Geschäftsmodell

Als Franchise Partner gewinnen Sie KMU-Inhaber (5-10 Klienten) als langfristige Mentoring-Mandate. Die Zusammenarbeit läuft über strukturierte KMU-Programme in drei Phasen:

  1. Discovery Session – Sie knüpfen eine Verbindung, verstehen die persönliche Motivation des Unternehmers, seine Hoffnungen und Herausforderungen.

  2. Profit Leakage Session – Mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool identifizieren Sie live, wo und wie viel Profit aus dem Unternehmen fließt. Sofortige, greifbare Erkenntnisse.

  3. Proposal Session – Gemeinsam planen Sie die Zusammenarbeit: welches Programm, welche Ziele, welche Schritte.

Klienten unterschreiben Verträge mit monatlicher Abrechnung – das schafft planbare, wiederkehrende Einnahmen für Sie und entlastet die Cashflow-Planung des Klienten.

Ein typisches Klienten-Portfolio: 5–10 KMU mit Mandatslaufzeiten von 12+ Monaten. Viele Beziehungen dauern mehrere Jahre.

Ihre Aufgaben als Franchise Partner

  • Klientenakquisition: Sie identifizieren und gewinnen KMU-Inhaber in Ihrer Region – durch Netzwerkarbeit, Empfehlungen und aktives Outreach.

  • Business Mentoring: Sie begleiten Ihre Klienten langfristig bei Wachstum, Profitabilitätssteigerung, Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge.

  • Profit Leakage Analysen: Sie führen strukturierte Unternehmensanalysen mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool durch und präsentieren klare, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse.

  • Programmbegleitung: Sie steuern aktiv ein Portfolio von 5–10 KMU-Klienten durch maßgeschneiderte KMU-Programme (Wachstum, Stabilisierung, Exit).

  • Netzwerkaufbau: Sie etablieren sich als anerkannter KMU-Experte in Ihrer Region – durch IHK-Engagements, Vorträge, Events und digitale Präsenz.

  • Eigenes Unternehmertum: Sie führen Ihr eigenes Unternehmen – von der Akquisition über die Leistungserbringung bis zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung.

  • Community & Netzwerk: Sie nehmen an regelmäßigen Peer-Exchanges, Trainings und Best-Practice-Sessions mit dem europaweiten thexton armstrong Netzwerk teil.

Was Sie bei uns finden

  • Neustart ohne Neuanfang: Ihre Erfahrung ist das Fundament – nicht das Problem.

  • Unternehmerische Freiheit: Kein Chef, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Abstimmungsschleifen.

  • Planbare Einnahmen: Langfristige Verträge und monatliche Abrechnung – keine Projektabhängigkeit.

  • Echte Wirkung: Sie helfen KMU-Inhabern sichtbar und messbar – das motiviert täglich neu.

  • Gemeinschaft: Ein Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Partner – kein einsames Freelancer-Dasein.

  • Unterstützung von Anfang an: 10-15-tägiges Onboarding, laufendes Coaching, fertige Tools und Templates, Unterstützung bei der Leadgenerierung.

Was Sie erhalten

  • Exklusive Regionallizenz: Ihr eigenes, geschütztes Territorium in Nord/Ostdeutschland.

  • Bewährte Methodik: Vollständige Toolbox inkl. Profit Leakage Applikation, Klientenprogramme, Playbooks und Templates – ab Tag 1 einsetzbar.

  • 10-15-tägiges Onboarding: Intensive Einarbeitung in Foundation und KMU-Programme über zwei Monate – praxisnah und strukturiert.

  • Laufendes Coaching: Regelmäßige 1-on-1-Begleitung durch den Master Franchise Partner Christian von Volkmann und das internationale Team.

  • Marketing & Vertrieb: Fertige Kampagnen, Klientenmaterialien, Podio CRM, LinkedIn-Templates und digitale Marketingunterstützung.

  • Peer-Netzwerk: Zugang zu 25+ Franchise Partnern und deren Netzwerk in NL, BE, UK und Deutschland – Peer Exchanges, Best Practices, gemeinsame Entwicklung.

  • Wiederkehrende Einnahmen: Jahresverträge mit monatlicher Abrechnung schaffen planbare, stabile Einnahmen – ohne Projektabhängigkeit.

  • Unternehmerische Freiheit: Sie führen Ihr eigenes Unternehmen – unabhängig, flexibel und ohne interne Konzernpolitik.

Wir suchen keine Lizenz-Nehmer. Wir suchen erfahrene Unternehmer, Führungskräfte und Berater, die den nächsten großen Schritt machen wollen – mit Rückhalt, Methodik und Gemeinschaft.

Erfahrung

  • General Management oder Erfahrung in mind. 2 Funktionsbereichen (Sales, Finance, Operations, Strategy)

  • Oder: Erfahrung als (Mit-)Inhaber oder Investor eines Unternehmens

  • Oder: Aktiv als unabhängiger Business Consultant oder Coach

  • Mindestens 15 Jahre Berufserfahrung auf Senior-Management-Ebene mit P&L-Verantwortung

  • 5+ Jahre KMU und B2B-Erfahrung oder ausgeprägte Affinität zur Klientenakquisition

Persönlichkeit

  • Empathisch, neugierig, menschenorientiert – Sie hören wirklich zu

  • Unternehmerisch denkend, positiv, proaktiv und zielorientiert

  • Resilient – Sie halten durch, auch wenn es mal schwieriger wird

  • Starker Kommunikator und Netzwerker

Voraussetzungen

  • Lokale Verwurzelung in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland (mind. 5 Jahre)

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau + sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Stabile persönliche Lebenssituation

  • Ausreichende finanzielle Mittel für Lizenzgebühr und Betriebskapital in der Anlaufphase

  • Es handelt sich hierbei nicht um eine sozialversicherungspflichtige Anstellung

Gut zu wissen: Unterstützung bei Gründungszuschuss der Bundesagentur für Arbeit und KfW Darlehen

Qualifizierte Kandidaten können einen Gründungszuschuss der BA erhalten (bis zu 15 Monate staatliche Förderung zur Absicherung der Gründungsphase) oder zinsvergünstigte Darlehen der KfW mit Tilgunsaussetzung in den ersten Jahren zur Erleichterung der Anlaufphase. jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up.

Full-time

About SOUS

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

About the role

SOUS helps independent food and beverage entrepreneurs grow by building what we believe will be the last employee a restaurant owner ever has to hire that touches a screen. After a strong start in the Netherlands, Germany is now one of our most important growth markets, and we are scaling our team there quickly.

As Sales Manager Germany you bring SOUS to independent restaurants across the country. You are one of the first people building our German sales team, which means real ownership, a big market to win and a fast track to grow with it.

Your team

You join the Sales team Germany and report to the Sales Lead Germany, as part of the international sales organisation led by our Global Head of Sales. You work closely with our teams in Amsterdam across Growth, Partnerships and Merchant Success.

Tasks

Your role in this growth

  • Focus fully on new business and drive consistent growth in the single and multi-outlet restaurant segments in Germany

  • Own your complete sales funnel: follow up warm leads, create new opportunities, close deals and nurture customer relationships

  • Work with autonomy and full responsibility, paired with clear targets

  • Collaborate closely with the Sales Lead Germany on regional expansion and larger accounts

  • Help shape the German sales playbook as we scale the team

  • Follow a defined progression path towards Senior Sales Manager or other commercial roles

Key responsibilities

  • Build and manage a strong outbound and inbound pipeline in the German food and beverage market

  • Run consultative sales conversations with chefs and restaurant owners, remote and on site

  • Convert both hot and cold leads into qualified opportunities and closed deals

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting through to onboarding

  • Share local market insights with marketing and product, from Lieferando dynamics to regional differences

Requirements

  • 2 to 6 years of sales experience; a SaaS, hospitality or startup background is preferred

  • Strong communication skills with a consultative, solution-oriented approach

  • Comfortable working with targets, CRM workflows and structured outreach

  • Affinity with the food and beverage sector, AI and digital products

  • An existing network in the German restaurant or food and beverage industry is a plus

  • Native or fluent German and good English

  • Willing to travel for merchant visits and regular team days in Amsterdam

Benefits

  • Base salary of €50,000 to €62,000 gross per year, depending on experience

  • Uncapped bonus structure

  • 25 holiday days plus public holidays

  • Remote working in Germany, with regular team days at our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam

  • Travel budget for merchant visits, events and trips to Amsterdam

  • Personal development budget and direct access to an experienced leadership team

  • An ambitious team of food lovers who move fast and celebrate wins together

Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

 

About the Role 🤔

Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us.

Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for.

 

Function one: enablement

Training and standards

  • Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there.

  • Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how.

  • Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar.

Documentation and materials

  • Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice.

  • Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed.

The channel to marketing

  • Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer.

The channel to product

  • Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when.

  • When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it.

Function two: conversion

Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there.

Call scoring

  • Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise.

  • Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it.

  • Send the reports out every week, to everyone.

  • Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team.

  • Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten.

  • Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster.

KYC

  • Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process

  • Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip.

  • Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed.

  • Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written.

  • Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team.

How we will measure it 💻

  • Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort.

  • KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average.

  • Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly.

  • 80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment.

  • You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent.

  • You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand.

  • You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck.

  • You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it.

  • You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use.

  • You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them.

  • Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is seeking a 2LoD Compliance Strategist to provide dedicated independent second-line assurance across Ramp UK & Irish regulated businesses.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn regulatory expectations into a practical, evidence-led monitoring and assurance programme.

The role sits within Ramp's Europe Compliance function and supports the Head of Compliance & MLRO - Europe. You will not own first-line operational decisions or perform routine casework. Instead, you will independently test and challenge the design and operation of financial-crime, safeguarding, payments, outsourcing, governance, and regulatory-change controls. You will make sure that findings are understood, remediated by accountable owners, and independently validated before closure.

Ramp Payments Europe is developing across multiple legal entities, jurisdictions, payment rails, banking partners, product journeys, and shared Group services. En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".

Notre activité Strategy accompagne les dirigeants et investisseurs dans la résolution de problématiques complexes. Sa valeur ajoutée est de proposer des solutions réalistes et quantifiées, en combinant des approches stratégiques et opérationnelles. Afin d’accompagner sa forte croissance, nous recherchons actuellement des Senior Consultants et Consultantes (3 à 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle hors stage). L’activité Strategy compte aujourd’hui plus de 150 collaborateurs en Europe, issus des cabinets de conseils ou des entreprises.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Rejoindre l’équipe Strategy c’est prendre part à l’aventure entrepreneuriale du cabinet, en ayant un rôle essentiel dans le développement de l’activité. Pour maximiser notre impact chez les clients, nous adoptons des cycles de travail courts grâce à des sprints successifs. Cela favorise la rotation des équipes et accélère l'apprentissage. De plus, un programme de formation complet et un mentorat assuré par des collaborateurs(trices) plus expérimenté(e)s, permet à nos consultant(e)s de développer et approfondir rapidement les compétences du métier. Notre large portefeuille de clients vous permettra également de découvrir de nombreux secteurs d’activité et des contextes d’entreprises variés.

En nous rejoignant vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes d’intervention suivants :

‘Deal Strategy & Exécution’ : Dans le cadre d’une transaction, en préparation ('pre-deal’) ou en exécution (‘post-deal’), vous accompagnerez des vendeurs comme des acheteurs durant tout le processus.

En préparation du deal :

  • Définition de l’Equity Story (rationnel de l’opération et stratégie de développement)

  • Réalisation de due diligence stratégique, commerciale, opérationnelle et ESG

  • Evaluation des potentielles synergies issues d’un rapprochement

  • Plan de séparation (‘Carve-out’)

Lors de l’exécution du deal :

  • Préparation de plan d’intégration (‘PMI’) et définition de la stratégie et des actions nécessaires pour garantir la continuité de l’activité ('Day 1 readiness’)

  • Mise en œuvre de plan de synergies

  • Animation et pilotage de la performance

‘Corporate Strategy & Business transformation’ : Vous participerez à la construction et à la mise en œuvre de plans stratégiques et de programmes de transformation, avec notamment :

  • Construction de plans stratégiques : plan de transformation, plan de création de valeur, repositionnement stratégique, définition de solutions et offres innovantes

  • Conception de programmes d’excellence commerciale et de développement du revenu, de nouveaux business models, de plan marketing, de plan de performance des ventes et d’amélioration de la relation client

  • Définition de nouveaux business models et innovation, de plan marketing, de plan de performance des ventes et d’amélioration de la relation client

  • Conception de projets d’excellence opérationnelle d’amélioration des performances (manufacturing, supply chain, etc.)

  • Conception de programmes de transformation digitale ou technologique

  • Mise en place des feuilles de route d’un Business Plan

  • Accompagnement des entreprises dans leurs enjeux liés aux sujets ESG

‘Turnaround & Operational Restructuring’ : Dans des contextes de sous-performance ou de crise, vous participerez à la construction et mise en œuvre de plans de retournement, avec notamment :

  • Construction et mise en œuvre de plans de retournement, avec si nécessaire la rationalisation de l'empreinte industrielle et des réseaux de distribution, la refonte de l’organisation et l’optimisation du Besoin en Fonds de Roulement

  • Mise en place et pilotage de cellules dédiées (« CRO Office ») avec notamment la construction de plans stratégiques dans des contextes de sous-performance,

  • Reprise en main de filiales ou d'activités déficitaires

En tant que Senior Consultant(e), vous serez le/la référent(e) d’un ou plusieurs chantiers sur vos missions. Vous vous verrez confier la responsabilité de l’avancement des analyses et des rapports. Vous serrez en contact direct avec vos clients dans le cadre des ateliers et des comités de pilotage. Votre rôle portera également sur l’accompagnement des équipes avec lesquelles vous serez amené(e) à intervenir.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce), ayant acquis 3 à 5 ans d’expérience parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil en stratégie ou au sein d’une équipe stratégie en entreprise

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences opérationnelles (Supply Chain, achats, contrôle de gestion industriel, Manufacturing, logistique, excellence commerciale) avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers

  • Une expérience opérationnelle en entreprise dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines opérationnels et / ou financiers

Vous êtes doté(e) de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux(se), dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère serait un plus). Vous êtes motivé(e) par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à forts enjeux stratégiques marqués par des enjeux marchés ou de retournement ainsi que d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions financières et opérationnelles. Vous avez envie de vivre une aventure entrepreneuriale en participant à la forte croissance de Eight Advisory.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, T2 / Target2 Payment Operations
jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.
  • Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.
  • Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).
  • Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.
  • Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

  • Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.
  • The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.
  • After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions
  • Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)
  • Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging
  • Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams
  • Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance
  • Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration
  • Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes
What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Key Account- en Field Salesmanager
jobs.description:
Als jij klaar bent voor een volgende stap in jouw carrière is dit een mooie kans! Wil jij commerciële impact maken bij Key Accounts in de foodretail en een buitendienstteam naar een hoger niveau tillen? Bij Remark Groep krijg je de vrijheid om te ondernemen, heb je invloed op de commerciële koers en draag je verantwoordelijkheid over bekende A-merken. Een gecombineerde rol van Key Accountmanager en Field Salesmanager voor een ervaren salesprofessional met leiderschapsambities. Door jouw aanpak draag je direct bij aan commerciële groei, een fijne samenwerking en professionalisering van het team. Je bouwt, stuurt, coacht en bepaalt mede de commerciële koers.

Maak het verschil als Key Account- en Field Salesmanager in Rogat
Dankzij jouw commerciële inzicht en coachende leiderschap groeien zowel de retailrelaties als de prestaties van het buitendienstteam. Als Key Account- & Field Salesmanager bij Remark Groep combineer je strategisch key accountmanagement met het aansturen en ontwikkelen van drie field sales professionals. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de commerciële afspraken op hoofdkantoorniveau en bouwt tegelijkertijd aan een zelfstandig opererend buitendienstteam dat zorgt voor optimale distributie, schappresentaties en promotionele activaties bij drogisterijen, apotheken en gezondheidswinkels. Je bent zichtbaar op de winkelvloer, gaat regelmatig mee op klantbezoek en vertaalt commerciële data naar concrete verbeteracties. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met marketing, sales en andere interne disciplines.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

· coaching-on-the-job, ontwikkelen en aansturen van buitendienstcollega’s;

· opbouwen en uitbreiden van strategische relaties met Key Accounts in de foodretail en het maken van accountplannen, waardoor jaarafspraken en promoties nagekomen worden;

· bewaken van commerciële KPI’s en vertalen van data naar gerichte acties;

· structureren van planning, forecasting, rapportages en commerciële routines;

· versterken van winkelvloerexecutie en samenwerking met interne stakeholders.

Als gedreven Key Account- en Field Salesmanager kun jij rekenen op:
Een ondernemende positie waarin jij veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte krijgt om zichtbaar resultaat neer te zetten. Remark Groep is een groeiende organisatie met sterke merken als THERME, ZARQA, Bio-Oil, Vogue, DARO, Midalgan en De Vergulde Hand biedt een hechte, professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen, volop samenwerking en mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

· salaris van € 58.000,- tot €85.000,- bruto per jaar (incl. vakantiegeld), inschaling afhankelijk van senioriteit;

· bonusregeling;

· 27 vakantiedagen;

· een toekomstbestendige pensioenregeling;

· een auto, iPhone en laptop van de zaak;

· personeelskorting op de producten;

· gezellige borrels, uitjes en gezamenlijke lunches;

· mogelijkheden tot opleidingen en trainingen.

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:
Jij combineert coachend leiderschap met commerciële slagkracht en analytisch vermogen. Je werkt planmatig, houdt overzicht en durft duidelijke lijnen uit te zetten. Je werkt gestructureerd en schakelt gemakkelijk tussen strategische klantgesprekken en de dagelijkse praktijk op de winkelvloer. Met jouw ondernemende instelling zie je commerciële kansen en zet je deze om in concrete resultaten.


Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

· hbo werk- en denkniveau;

· relevante ervaring met Key Accountmanagement en/of het het aansturen van een buitendienst binnen FMCG of retail;

· je past bij de belangrijkste bedrijfswaarden: Ondernemerschap, Samenwerken en Merkgedrevenheid;

· kennis van winkelpromoties, schappresentatie, displays, voorraadbeheer en second placements;

· ervaring met accountplannen, rapportages en het datagedreven sturen op commerciële KPI’s;

· goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Jouw werkgebied

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Technicien(ne) Produit Maille Senior pour rejoindre notre pôle Développement Produit pour un CDD de 6 mois. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • Assurer la prise de mesures des modèles à chaque étape du développement (prototypes, shooting samples, shipment samples, size sets et pièces scellées).
  • Participer activement aux essayages aux côtés de la styliste, identifier les défauts de mise au point et proposer des solutions techniques adaptées.
  • Rédiger les commentaires techniques (fléchages, sections de montage, annotations en français ou en anglais) sur Illustrator et élaborer les fiches de mesures sur Excel.
  • Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des fournisseurs sur les aspects techniques tout au long du processus de mise au point, en français comme en anglais.
  • Contribuer aux projets transverses de l’équipe visant à améliorer et harmoniser le bien-aller des modèles.
  • Valider les lancements en production auprès des usines et définir les gradations adaptées.
  • Réaliser les tests au porter et au lavage, analyser les résultats et partager les conclusions avec les équipes Production, Qualité et Technique.
  • Contrôler la conformité des shipment samples et des pièces scellées en collaboration avec les équipes Qualité et Production, identifier les éventuelles non-conformités et assurer le suivi des actions correctives auprès des fournisseurs.
  • Assurer le suivi des réceptions de prototypes, effectuer les relances nécessaires et mettre à jour les outils de suivi de production.
  • Piloter le planning de mise au point en coordination avec l’équipe Production, dans le respect des échéances fixées.
  • Participer aux réunions consacrées aux conseils de taille et à l’analyse des taux de retour.

Vous serez garant(e) du bien-aller des modèles, depuis leur développement jusqu’à leur livraison.

Requirements

  • De formation supérieure en école de mode modélisme/production, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 5 ans minimum à un poste équivalent.
  • Vous avec des connaissances sur le vêtement et une forte sensibilité produit maille et jersey  

Qualités recherchées:

  • Faire preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie, de réactivité et d’adaptabilité.
  • Démontrer un sens aigu des responsabilités et des priorités.
  • Disposer d’un excellent esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à travailler en collaboration.

Compétences et savoir-faire requis :

  • Maîtriser le Pack Office et Adobe Illustrator.
  • Maîtriser l’anglais courant et technique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. C'est notre garantie de qualité pour toi, pour ton équipe, et pour nos clients.

Phase 1 : Tu vends.

  • Apprentissage du marché : Tu comprends dans le détail les besoins des salons, les objections récurrentes et ce qui fait signer un·e gérant·e.

Phase 2 : Tu construis et tu diriges.

  • Lead by example : Tu passes plus de 80 % de ton temps sur le terrain avec ton équipe; tu accompagnes et tu coaches la prospection, tu assistes aux démos et tu aides activement à transformer les opportunités en signatures.

Ton profil

  • Passion pour la vente terrain : Au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience en vente terrain / commerce itinérant (le B2B est un plus). Tu adores être en première ligne.

  • Autonomie & sens stratégique : Tu planifies tes activités en toute autonomie, tu fixes des priorités claires et trouves des moyens intelligents d'implanter Salonkee dans ta région.

  • Affinité tech : Bonne compréhension des solutions digitales et solide expérience des CRM.

  • Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Strasbourg et alentours.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales..

Ce que nous offrons

  • Rémunération attractive : Un fixe solide + des commissions non plafonnées; ta performance paie, dès le premier mois et à chaque étape.

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Un plan d'évolution transparent : Du terrain vers le leadership, avec des jalons définis dès ton arrivée.

  • Organisation autonome : Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. jobs.title: Responsable Digital Solutions (CIO)
jobs.description:
Innosuisse, l’Agence suisse pour l’encouragement de l’innovation, soutient l’innovation fondée sur la science pour la Suisse de demain et aide les start-up et les PME à saisir les opportunités de l’avenir et à être compétitives à l’échelle internationale.

Afin d’ancrer la numérisation au niveau de la direction élargie, Innosuisse a créé la nouvelle fonction de Responsable Digital Solutions (CIO).

En tant que membre de la direction élargie, vous assumez la responsabilité de la stratégie, de l’infrastructure et de l’exploitation informatiques d’Innosuisse. Vous faites le lien entre la technologie et les objectifs de l’organisation, faites avancer la transformation numérique et poursuivez le développement de l’unité Digital Solutions avec les domaines IT Operations & Technology, Business Solutions ainsi que Security & Governance.

Vos tâches

  • Élaboration d’une feuille de route en matière de numérisation et d’IA, étroitement alignée sur les objectifs d’Innosuisse

  • Direction d’initiatives de numérisation et de programmes de transformation

  • Responsabilité d’une exploitation stable, performante et sûre sur Azure et M365, y compris le développement du système central « Innolink »

  • Développement et direction de Digital Solutions avec des collaboratrices et collaborateurs internes et externes

  • Responsabilité du budget informatique, de la planification des investissements et du pilotage du portefeuille

  • Responsabilité de la sécurité informatique, de la conformité, de la continuité des activités et de la reprise après sinistre

  • Pilotage des partenaires externes et conduite des procédures de marchés publics (OMC)

  • Représentation des thèmes de la numérisation et de l’informatique auprès de la direction, du conseil d’administration et du conseil de l’innovation

Votre profil

  • Diplôme d’une haute école en informatique, électrotechnique, sciences de l’ingénieur, informatique de gestion ou dans un domaine comparable

  • Plusieurs années d’expérience de direction dans une fonction informatique dirigeante, idéalement au niveau C

  • Solide expérience en stratégie informatique, numérisation, architecture informatique et transformation, y compris la gestion du changement

  • Expérience des technologies et stratégies d’IA, du développement agile d’applications et de la sécurité informatique

  • Expérience de la gestion des services informatiques et du portefeuille de projets, solide compréhension de la gestion d’entreprise

  • Idéalement, expérience des marchés publics (OMC) et du pilotage de partenaires de développement externes

  • Esprit stratégique et entrepreneurial, sens pragmatique de la mise en œuvre, excellentes aptitudes à la communication

  • Capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes et à rallier les collaboratrices et collaborateurs au changement

  • Enthousiasme pour les nouvelles technologies, l’innovation et la recherche

  • Très bonnes connaissances de l’allemand et de l’anglais ainsi que bonnes connaissances du français ou de l’italien

Lieu de travail : Berne. Taux d’occupation : 100 %.

Innosuisse vous offre

  • Un environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique, dans lequel vous contribuez à l’encouragement de l’innovation fondée sur la science en Suisse, dans l’intérêt de l’économie et de la société.

  • Un champ d’activités varié au cœur de l’innovation suisse, où vous mettez à profit vos connaissances et votre expérience et contribuez à ce que des produits et services hautement innovants soient soutenus avec succès.

jobs.title: Fleet Management Data Analyst SIOP - Rotterdam
jobs.description:
International, centrally positioned role with direct impact on the deployment of thousands of tank containers worldwide.

You have a good job. But you feel there’s more in it for you.

Maybe you’re looking for greater international impact. Or you’re ready to move beyond environments where data lags behind reality.

At our client, that’s exactly the challenge.

Today, the global fleet is still largely managed through manual spreadsheets. Data is fragmented, often outdated, and not available in real time.

You are going to fundamentally change that.

For one of the world’s largest tank container leasing companies — managing over 75,000 tank containers globally — we are looking for a Data Analyst for an internationally focused, centrally positioned role based in Rotterdam.

In this role, you don’t just report on numbers — you directly influence the deployment, availability, and planning of tank containers worldwide. Your work ensures that stakeholders across the globe can generate accurate, real-time reports at any moment and use them for decision-making.

This level of tangible impact is rare in a data analyst role.

About the organization

Our client is one of the largest tank container leasing companies in the world. With a global fleet and international customer base, data plays an increasingly critical role in its success.

The organization is undergoing a transition from manual, Excel-driven processes to data-driven operations with real-time insights.

As part of the Marmon Group (a Berkshire Hathaway company), you benefit from a strong international foundation combined with the dynamics of an evolving organization.

The culture is open, international, and results-driven, offering significant responsibility and room for initiative.

Tasks

Your challenge

As a Data Analyst, you operate at the heart of an international operation. You ensure a single source of truth and support the Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) process.

You work with data from multiple systems — including ERP (legacy), CRM (Dynamics), WMS, and depot software — and translate this data into clear, actionable insights.

You identify deviations and convert them into concrete actions that directly impact operations.

You ensure stakeholders no longer rely on outdated figures, but instead work with real-time dashboards and reporting that drive international decision-making.

You report directly to the Global Fleet Manager and collaborate closely with stakeholders across Operations, Finance, and IT.

Although you work within an international team, your role is centrally positioned in Rotterdam, supporting global fleet management across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and China.

The first months are critical for success.
You start by taking over existing processes and ensuring continuity in reporting. From there, you progressively improve, automate, and professionalize data and dashboards.

What will you do?

  • Consolidate, structure, and validate data from multiple sources
  • Ensure reliable and consistent data across global operations
  • Build and improve real-time dashboards and reporting in Power BI
  • Develop and monitor KPIs for the global fleet
  • Analyze deviations and drive performance improvements
  • Translate data into actionable insights and business decisions

You make the difference by making data usable — not just visible.

Requirements

Your profile

This role suits you if you look beyond numbers and want to make a real impact in an international supply chain environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree (e.g. in Data, Supply Chain, or Business Administration)
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst within a logistics, manufacturing, or supply chain environment
  • Strong skills in Excel, Power BI (including DAX), and SQL
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns quickly
  • Confident and effective in working with international stakeholders
  • Proactive, with the ability to provide both solicited and unsolicited advice

International experience is essential.
You have worked in a global supply chain environment (e.g. logistics, leasing, shipping, or manufacturing) and have proven experience with SIOP processes.

You are not a pure IT specialist, but a business-oriented data analyst who understands how processes work and how data drives decision-making.

Additionally:

  • Fluent in English (Dutch is a plus)
  • Available for a full-time role (40 hours)
  • Comfortable working across multiple time zones

Technical qualifications

In this role, you operate at the intersection of data and supply chain. Therefore, experience with the following is important:

  • Approximately 4–7 years of experience in data or business analytics within supply chain or SIOP
  • SQL, data modeling (star/snowflake), Power BI (DAX), and Excel (Power Query / Power Pivot)
  • Data quality frameworks and master data management
  • Demand planning, inventory management, and SIOP processes
  • Connecting operational and financial data
  • Collaboration with Finance on reporting and forecasting
  • Working with international stakeholders across multiple time zones

Preferred
D365 F&O · Azure / Synapse / Databricks / Data Lake · SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or Anaplan · Python or R · Power Automate · external data sources (market data, POS, distribution data)

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

A role with real impact, within an international organization that is evolving rapidly.

  • Gross monthly salary up to €5,800 (based on full-time, depending on experience)
  • One-year contract with the prospect of a permanent position
  • 26 vacation days + 8% holiday allowance
  • Laptop and mobile phone
  • Personal development budget (training, courses, tools)
  • Collective pension scheme

You will have the opportunity to shape this role and make a direct contribution to the organization’s professionalization.

Apply

Excited? Apply now.

If you have any questions, please contact:
Maurice den Hartog – MdH Recruitment
+31 6 46700806

We may close the vacancy early once a suitable candidate is found — so don’t wait too long.

jobs.description:

Je vertaalt bedrijfsdoelstellingen naar slimme, schaalbare CE-oplossingen die aantoonbare business value leveren.
​
​Dankzij jouw diepgaande kennis van de applicatie, bedrijfsprocessen en sectorcontext ben je een volwaardige gesprekspartner voor stakeholders op alle niveaus. Je adviseert over procesoptimalisatie, adoptie en inrichting, en begeleidt klanten in hun digitale transformatie.

Ben jij een ervaren Dynamics 365 CE Consultant, of heb je al meerdere jaren sterke functionele ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement? Dan komen we graag met je in contact om te verkennen hoe jij impact kunt maken binnen 9altitudes.

Taken

Je dagelijkse avontuur:

​Je werkt in multidisciplinaire projectteams samen met pre-sales, projectmanagers & consultants. Daarbij maken we gebruik van onze pragmatische, agile implementatieaanpak en bewezen best practices. Bij 9altitudes werk je aan Customer Engagement-implementaties van uiteenlopende omvang en complexiteit voor klanten in onze kernsectoren. Dit bied je veel variatie én de kans om kennis te maken met diverse organisaties en werkomgevingen.

​Jouw uitdaging als Dynamics 365 CE Consultant:

  • ​Je analyseert functionele wensen en eisen van klanten en vertaalt deze naar slimme oplossingen binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, het Power Platform én innovatieve AI-functionaliteiten zoals Microsoft Copilot;
  • ​Je hebt een adviserende rol in de inrichting en optimalisatie van commerciële, marketing- en serviceprocessen;
  • ​Je hebt kennis van Dynamics 365 CE en adviseert klanten over de mogelijkheden, inclusief het verzorgen van demo’s, presentaties en workshops;
  • ​Je hebt een actieve rol in het uitwerken van functionele ontwerpen en oplossingsrichtingen binnen het projectteam;
  • ​Je hebt verantwoordelijkheid voor de configuratie van het systeem en de stapsgewijze realisatie van oplossingen tijdens implementaties;
  • ​Je hebt een belangrijke bijdrage aan adoptie en change management door middel van trainingen, documentatie en begeleiding richting livegang.

Vereisten

Vaardigheden:

​Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding;

  • ​Je hebt ervaring als consultant met Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE en/of met de implementatie van CE/CRM-oplossingen is een sterke pré;
  • ​Je bent analytisch sterk en werkt gestructureerd en methodisch;
  • ​Je bent een inhoudelijke en strategische sparringpartner voor klanten op verschillende niveaus;
  • ​Je bent commercieel gedreven en beschikt over een bedrijfskundige visie;
  • ​Je bent een proactieve, doortastende en oplossingsgerichte teamspeler;
  • ​Je bent professioneel, communicatief sterk en flexibel in je inzet;
  • ​Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager B2C
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ The Product Marketing Manager B2C opportunity

Building the engagement engine with Alan Play that makes 500k members come back to their health every single day, a key differentiator for Alan.

 

Today, 25k Alan members open Alan Play every day (120,000 every month) to walk, meditate, breathe, compete with their colleagues, build healthy habits. Play is Alan's #1 source of traffic and the retention engine of all our health services. And we are B2B2C: companies pay, members choose to engage. Play is a differentiator in deals, and at renewal. HR admins are also an underused distribution channel to reach members. Two audiences, one product story. By 2030 we want 500k daily users, across all our countries

 

The challenges: Our lifecycle is greenfield. Onboarding, activation, reminders, reactivation and win-back are owned by nobody today. We run events rebuilt almost from scratch, so the tenth Alan Cup costs as much as the first. We measure opens and clicks, not what a campaign actually did to daily engagement. And on the B2B side, our pitch goes stale between releases, as Play ships fast, so the sales argument does not keep up.

 

The future: A lifecycle layer designed for personalisation, running on the segmentation and experimentation platform Play has been building. Campaign machinery that gets cheaper every quarter. A measurement loop we trust, with holdouts and real incrementality. A live Play pitch that updates as features ship, so the field walks into a renewal or a deal with the current product. And HR admins turned into a real, measured distribution channel rather than a mailing list.

 

The hard parts: This role is horizontal, and vertical. Many member segments, many admin segments, several countries, coordination with Product as well as Sales, KAM and CSM, as well as other products teams who communicate with members.

 

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

 

Must haves

  • Retention and lifecycle marketing at scale on a consumer product - subscription, gaming, social, media, health and fitness. Where engagement and retention are the business.
