jobs.title: Chief Science Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾

Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” (The Real-World Learning Loop, Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise:

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely.

Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time.

Responsibilities

  • Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments.

  • Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop.

  • Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next.

  • Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot.

  • Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard.

  • Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm.

  • Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join.

  • Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation.

  • Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML.

  • Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships.

  • Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction.

Not in scope, by design

  • Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. They stay with the CTO and operations: the CTO owns how we build and ship, you own what we learn next.

  • A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer.

  • Product roadmap and pricing.

What makes this role hard

  • Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open.

  • Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system.

  • A result counts when it holds up in a customer’s operation, not when the paper is accepted.

Your first 12 months

  • First 90 days: know the fleet, the data and the team; agree the research roadmap with the founders; one evaluation standard everyone uses.

  • By month 6: a research organisation with clear ownership and a release rhythm from experiment to fleet.

  • By month 12: a new generation of Cortex in customer operations with measurable gains, key senior hires made, and work that puts Sereact on the map of robot learning.

What you bring

  • You have led research in robot learning or embodied AI (VLA models, imitation or reinforcement learning, world models) and built a team around it.

  • Your work runs on real robots, ideally outside the lab and for long stretches. You know what breaks first.

  • Scientific standing: a strong record at the top venues and a network that great researchers want to join.

  • You have made real calls on research bets, data and compute, and stopped what did not work.

  • You explain science to engineers, customers and investors alike, and you enjoy it.

  • PhD in machine learning, robotics or a related field, or an equivalent track record.

Nice to have: large-scale pretraining of foundation models · fleet learning or data engines · industrial manipulation · experience in both academia and industry.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Tell us about a model you took from a paper to a robot that ran for weeks without you. What broke first?

  2. If you had our deployment data tomorrow, which bet would you make first, and what would you stop?

  3. How do you decide what to publish and what to keep?

What we offer

  • Robots in live production that learn every day, and the data that comes with them.

  • A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with meaningful equity.

  • Large-scale compute and the freedom to build the research organisation you would want to work in.

  • Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support.

How we hire

Conversations with both founders, a research deep dive with the team, and a working session on a real problem from our deployments. We move fast.

Build an AI-Native Accounting Function

REQUIREMENTS

  • 🤖 AI & automation mindset: You're excited to experiment with AI, build better workflows, and learn how to validate automated outputs rather than simply execute transactions.

  • 📊 Systems & spreadsheet skills: You're confident using spreadsheets and accounting systems, with strong attention to coding accuracy, data quality, and financial controls.

  • 🎯 Ownership & reliability: You take responsibility for daily operations, follow through on commitments, and proactively identify ways to improve how things work.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🌍 International accounting: You have experience working across multiple entities, ideally in a global business with an expanding international footprint.

  • 💰 SaaS & revenue accounting: You're familiar with SaaS business models, multi-currency accounting, AR, or revenue recognition.

  • 🔍 Audit & qualifications: You bring an audit background or relevant accounting qualifications that strengthen your accounting expertise.

  • 🇩🇪 German language skills: You can communicate in German, although this is not required for the role.

Why join us?

At n8n, you won't just process transactions — you'll help rethink how accounting works at an automation company. You'll own meaningful parts of our accounting operations, build AI-powered improvements you can see in action, and help shape a scalable finance function at one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team where autonomy, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning are encouraged. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll have the opportunity to deepen your GL, P2P, and close expertise while gradually expanding into AR and revenue accounting as we grow.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of AI-native accounting.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Search Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows.
 
We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us.
 
Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.
 
Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 
 
 
🛠️ The Digital Marketing Team @ Bloom & Wild Group

The digital marketing team is responsible for driving sustainable growth in all of the markets we operate in through the execution of innovative, creative and measurable campaigns.

You’ll work on paid search campaigns targeting both new and existing customers, working across both our acquisition and retention teams to drive growth across multiple markets, brands and categories.

The wider team works collaboratively with internal stakeholders including brand, international, data, and product, while directly managing our external search agency to surface crucial insights and maximize campaign performance.


⚙️ What you'll be doing:

  • Own paid search strategy: lead paid search strategy, developing and executing campaigns across UK, DE, NL and other markets, ensuring alignment with wider marketing, brand and business goals – in particular, supporting Bloom & Wild Group's positioning as a gifting brand, not just selling flowers but also hampers, home, food & drink and more.

  • Own the budget: manage our search budget end-to-end, tracking CAC, LTV and retention costs (RC) to guide investment decisions.

  • Lead our agency partner: Oversee and manage third-party agency partner to execute high-performing campaigns and maximize ROI. Hold the agency accountable to performance targets, strict SLAs, and industry best practices, ensuring they continuously push the boundaries of modern search strategy by adopting cutting-edge tactics, beta programs, and new platform features.

  • Set the optimisation approach: set the keyword strategy, ad copy testing and audience-targeting approach that agency partners and stakeholders execute against, driving Quality Score, CTR and conversion efficiency.

  • Own App Campaigns: oversee Google App Campaigns and Apple Search Ads to drive installs and engagement, aligned to our retention and LTV goals.

  • Manage the Google relationship: work with our Google account manager to unlock alpha/beta opportunities, escalate issues and secure strategic support, along with our agency.

  • Own feed & process: own and continuously improve product feeds and backend processes for Google Shopping and Performance Max (PMax) campaigns.

  • Shape the roadmap: turn channel performance and data into clear, actionable insights that shape the wider paid media roadmap and forecasting, using Tableau and in-platform reporting.

  • Stay ahead of the platform: stay up to date with best practices and market insights, particularly with Google, to prepare for upcoming changes, test new features and champion the latest innovations.

  • Champion AI in search: maintain deep, practical knowledge of modern AI within search engine marketing – platform-level generative AI features, algorithmic updates and LLM-driven search behaviours – and share what you learn with the wider marketing team.

  • Be the go-to expert: act as the go-to person for paid search across the marketing team – mentoring junior colleagues, sharing learnings (e.g. through Lunch & Learns) and giving constructive feedback on paid search work outside your direct remit.

  • Protect share of voice: proactively monitor the competitor landscape, ensuring market share of voice, especially through peak trading moments.


    • ✅ You’ll love this role if you…

  • Are an expert in Google Paid Search: You have extensive, hands-on experience managing Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns at scale (experience with Microsoft Advertising or App Campaigns is a bonus).

  • Are fluent in tracking and analytics: You are comfortable working with analytics tools, conversion tracking, and Google Merchant Center, and feel confident navigating privacy- and consent-driven changes to measurement.

  • Love data and reporting: You are a data-driven decision-maker who thrives on deriving insights. You are comfortable using both in-platform tools and Tableau to analyze performance across our custom-built, proprietary e-commerce stack (non-Shopify).

  • Have agency management experience: You have a proven track record of managing third-party agencies to drive results and maintain strategic alignment.

  • Are proactive and hands-on: You take full responsibility and initiative to get things done, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in.

  • Are structured and organized: You take a thoughtful approach to planning, organization, and prioritizing your work to deliver on key business goals.

  • Are curious and adaptable: You love figuring out new tech, testing, learning, and trying new things, often taking the initiative to optimize and improve existing processes.

    •  
    These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you.
    🏡 Belonging @ Bloom & Wild
    We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers.  We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team.  Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working.  
     
    🧭 Our ways of working
    We really believe in the power of connection. For us that looks different depending on the team you work in. Some of our teams work together in person every day, whereas others may connect in person every quarter. 
    We also believe in flexibility that supports you, the work you do, and your team.  How much you work from home and from our office depends on a balance of those needs, and you’ll agree this with your manager.
    Whether it’s through a shared project, a learning and development opportunity, or an afterwork social - we trust our teams to make the right decisions (for them and us) about where and how they work each day.
     
    We’re big on collaboration, empathy, knowledge sharing and growth, and our values drive our priorities every day:
     
    Lead change for good: we have the guts to try new things and step up to do what matters most
    Think deeply, act swiftly: we make sure there’s thoughtful rationale behind our approach and always act swiftly to implement ideas 
    Care wildly: we pour care and creativity into everything we do and pay attention to the things that make a difference
    Stay open, be curious: we’re open about what we’re doing and why, and we welcome challenges from each other
     
    🌟 Work that works for you
    To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day. 
     
    Our perks and benefits include:
    ⏰ Flexible working & work from abroad 
    🌴 25 days holiday + your birthday + flexible bank holidays, & option to buy additional holiday each year
    💛 1 Volunteering day each year
    🐣 Enhanced family leave and a workplace nursery scheme
    🌱 A flexible training framework for every stage of your career 
    💐 Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions!
    📈 Share in our success with a choice to take equity options from day 1
    🏋 ClassPass membership: monthly credits to spend on fitness classes, yoga and much more! 
     
    For more information on our perks & bens, please see www.bloomandwild.com/careers
     
    🫱‍🫲 Getting hired
    We know that job searching can be daunting, and we want to do everything we can to ensure that your experience with us is a good one. Interviewing is a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’re the right move for you. 
     
    We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help you flourish throughout your application process with us, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience.

jobs.title: Director of University Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Enroly

Enroly helps universities transform the journey from application to arrival. Our platform combines Apply and CAS Shield to help institutions capture complete, decision-ready application data, streamline admissions workflows, manage international CAS issuance and strengthen compliance, creating one connected experience for applicants, agents and university teams.

We now work with over 100 UK universities, and hundreds of thousands of students and thousands of agents use the platform each year. Our data platform gives universities and key government contacts real-time, sector-wide insight to inform strategy.

In 2024, Enroly became part of Ecctis, a company with 30 years of being a globally respected authority in education, training, and skills development.

About the role

Reporting to the Group Chief Commercial Officer (CCO), you will develop new university partnerships from first conversation through to signed contract. You will lead a team of senior sales professionals while developing your own opportunities, leading from the front to demonstrate best practice, deliver results and raise your team’s commercial capability.

The location is remote, with regular travel to our London office, university campuses and sector events.

What you’ll do

University partnership growth

  • Own a personal pipeline of new universities, from first conversation to signed contract.
  • Lead complex sales involving directors and C-suite leaders across multiple departments, helping clients make informed purchasing decisions.
  • Drive conversion through university buying cycles, including frameworks, tenders and business cases.
  • Negotiate commercial terms and close deals that build sustainable, long-term client relationships.

Team leadership

  • Lead a team of senior sales professionals, setting individual targets with the CCO.
  • Run weekly pipeline reviews and coach live deals.
  • Embed the MEDDIC sales methodology and build team capability.
  • Develop the team’s higher education knowledge and relationship skills.
  • Address underperformance quickly and fairly and celebrate wins visibly.

Sector knowledge and profile

  • Develop trusted, senior relationships across the UK higher education sector.
  • Act as an adviser to universities on international recruitment, conversion and compliance challenges.
  • Stay ahead of UK higher education policy and trends.
  • Represent Enroly at sector events and with sector bodies.

Sales operations

  • Deliver accurate monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts.
  • Build the annual sales plan, covering territories, targets, headcount and activity.
  • Track pipeline coverage, conversion, cycle length and deal size, and act on what the data shows.

What we are looking for

Essential skills, experience, and attributes

  • Significant demonstrable experience in B2B sales, ideally selling SaaS or technical solutions, with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding personal targets.
  • Established experience selling into UK higher education providers or a similar sector.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK higher education sector, including international student recruitment.
  • Proven experience managing a target-carrying sales team while still closing deals yourself.
  • A track record of improving sales performance through coaching and enablement.
  • A consultative, relationship-led approach, with the credibility to advise senior university leaders.
  • Disciplined and accurate forecasting.
  • Based in the UK, the role holder will need to supply their own authorisation to work in the UK.

Desirable

  • Ability to bring an established network of senior contacts across UK universities, ideally in international, admissions, compliance or student services teams.
  • Relevant experience working inside a university, for example in international recruitment, admissions or compliance.
  • Familiarity with public procurement, frameworks and tenders in the sector.

What we offer

  • A competitive base salary dependent on experience, plus discretionary bonus and uncapped commission.
  • A dynamic, innovative work environment that celebrates successes and nurtures professional growth.
  • 26 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
  • Pension, private healthcare, home-working allowance, training allowance
  • EV Car Scheme, Cycle Scheme, BHN discount platform
  • Free flu vaccination vouchers, and more!

At Enroly, we believe in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. For more information on how we handle and protect your personal data, please review our Privacy Policy.

How to apply

Please submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so early applications are encouraged.

jobs.title: Responsable Financier France (H/F/N)
jobs.description:
Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.  
 
Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
 
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

Votre mission 

Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement, Ekimetrics cherche un Responsable Administratif et Financier pour le l’entité France. 

La personne qui nous rejoindra aura pour principale mission de piloter et suivre la réalisation de la stratégie financière de l'entreprise et d’accompagner son développement. Elle fera partie du comité de direction d’Ekimetrics France, en travaillant en relation avec l’équipe financière groupe, dans un environnement tech en forte croissance, tourné vers l'innovation et l'intégration de l'IA dans les processus métier.  

Rattaché(e) directement au CFO Groupe, vous encadrerez un Contrôleur de Gestion et un(e) stagiaire. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes financières locales, et Groupe les départements opérationnels et les fonctions support (Juridique, RH, IT, RSE) à l'échelle internationale. 

Votre mission consiste à :  

Suivi de la performance de l’activité 

  • Appuyer la prise de décision de la direction sur des sujets tels que l’optimisation de la marge brute et l’adéquation des ressources, en lien étroit avec le responsable des opérations, 

  • Collaborer avec les équipes transverses en fournissant des modélisations et analyses financières à l’appui de la prise de décision, 

  • Contribuer avec les équipes centrales à la réduction des délais de clôture mensuelle,  

  • Travailler avec les responsables budgétaires pour suivre et contrôler les dépenses réelles par rapport au budget. 

  • Superviser la clôture mensuelle avec l’équipe comptable du groupe, 

  • Produire et analyser le reporting financier et opérationnel mensuel (y compris compte de résultat avec l’analyse des KPIs), 

  • Animer le processus budgétaire et de « rolling forecast » au sein de l’entité, conformément aux directives et calendrier du groupe, 

  • Veiller à la mise en place de contrôles financiers robustes pour les activités commerciales, 

  • Identifier et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de systèmes, outils et d’utilisation de l’IA dans nos différents processus afin d’accroître l’efficacité et l’efficience de la fonction finance. 

  • Participer à des projets Groupe de mise en place du P2P, de passage à des nouvelles normes comptables, de réconciliation des flux intercos, et de mise en place de la « roadmap » IT Finance.  

Opérations 

  • Collaborer avec les RH pour le traitement des paiements de la paie, la simulation des augmentations de salaire,  

  • Travailler avec l’administration des ventes globale sur le recouvrement des encaissements, 

  • Entretenir et développer les relations avec les parties prenantes externes, notamment les experts-comptables externes, les auditeurs, les banques et les administrations fiscales (CIR et autres), 

  • Superviser la conformité réglementaire de l’entité, notamment en matière de prix de transfert, de paiements et d’audit légal, sans s’y limiter, 

  • Travailler avec les auditeurs pour la conformité et l’approbation des comptes annuels.  

Votre profil  

Idéalement, vous êtes :  

  • Diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en gestion financière, vous justifiez de 10 ans d’expérience en audit et en finance d'entreprise. 

  • Technophile, curieux.euse, ouvert.e d'esprit et familier.e des enjeux de la data, vous avez la volonté de développer vos compétences et de poursuivre votre carrière dans un environnement scaleup en développement,  

  • Rigoureux.euse, organisé.e et autonome, vous saurez faire preuve d'initiative et être rapidement opérationnel.le 

  • ·Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez les faire parler. 

  • Excellentes capacités de communication, d'influence et de résolution de problèmes, avec une aisance à évoluer dans un contexte matriciel et international.  

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais et du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.  

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
 
Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 
 
Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.
 
Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.
 
En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.
 
Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.
 
Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  
 
Vous aurez accès :
 
·       Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
·       A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ;
·       De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;
·       Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards)
·       Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
 
En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

 

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche  articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au Centre SPIN.

Le centre « Sciences des Processus Industriels et Naturels » (SPIN) est un centre de recherche, d’enseignement et de transfert technologique reconnu pour son expertise en Génie des Procédés appliqué aux solides divisés. Il est au service de l’innovation pour les entreprises industrielles confrontées à la transition numérique et environnementale. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans le département « Procédés de Transformation des Solides et Instrumentation » (PTSI) et dans le Laboratoire Georges Friedel UMR CNRS 5307.

Le projet proposé ici consistera à développer de capteurs de gaz à partir de matériaux fonctionnels. L’étude des interactions solide/gaz sera menée en parallèle des caractérisations électriques sous atmosphère gazeuse complexe (bancs de test avec génération contrôlée de polluants).

Cette étude sera menée en collaboration avec des chercheurs de IMT Mines Albi qui ont en charge la synthèse des matériaux sensibles et de IMT Atlantique pour l’intégration ultérieure du capteur dans des vêtements.

Dans le cadre du développement de capteurs, les matériaux sensibles seront déposés sur des supports préalablement équipés d’électrodes. Cette phase devra être optimisée afin de pouvoir effectuer des caractérisations reproductibles. La stabilité, la sensibilité à différents gaz et la sélectivité à un gaz donné seront étudiées. Pour cela, des tests sous gaz cibles seront réalisés et analysés, en atmosphère simple dans un premier temps jusqu’à des tests sous atmosphères plus représentatives d’un environnement réel. Ensuite, des études d’adsorption seront réalisées, un équipement de chimisorption sera utilisé afin d’étudier l’interaction solide (matériau sensible) / gaz et permettra d’apporter une compréhension sur les mécanismes de détection, de capture ou de traitement.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’une thèse dans les domaines sciences pour l’ingénieur/chimie/matériaux et idéalement avec une expérience en mise en forme de matériaux organiques ou céramiques par voir humide ou en mesure de propriétés électrique ou électrochimique ou en caractérisation de capteurs de gaz.

·         Titulaire d’un doctorat en Sciences pour l’ingénieur, Chimie ou Matériaux

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

jobs.description:
Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Zoek je een afstudeerstage en heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing?

We hebben jouw creativiteit en vernieuwende ideeën nodig! Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een creatieve student die ons helpt met het maken van marketingcampagnes in woord én beeld. Dit betekent een focus op content creatie en/of growth marketing.

Wat ga je doen?

Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen.

Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals:

  • Vormgeving;

  • Webinarproducties;

  • Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud;

  • E-mail marketing; 

  • Social media; 

  • Deep dive in de analytics;

  • Meedenken in plannen rondom AI.

Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan.

Met wie werk je samen?
Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. Genoeg mogelijkheden dus om samen te groeien en van elkaar te leren. 

Maud over haar stage bij 12Build:

“12Build is voor mij een plek waar ik mezelf kan en mag ontwikkelen. Ik voel me vanaf het eerste moment welkom in een super leuk team. Er is fijne begeleiding, ruimte om vragen te stellen en feedback te geven/ontvangen. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.”

Wie is 12Build?
12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren.


Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Je volgt HBO of WO-opleiding in marketing, communicatie of aanverwant (zoals creative business, bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, artificial intelligence, business analytics of marketing analytics);

  • Je zoekt een afstudeerstage en bent beschikbaar per februari 2027, voor een periode van ca. 1/2 jaar.

  • 3e jaars student en op zoek naar een stage voor dezelfde duur en periode? ook jij bent welkom om te reageren!

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal foutloos, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; 

  • And English would be great, since about 1/3rd of our colleagues has an international background;

  • Auch Deutsch wäre schön;

  • Daarnaast ontvang je bonuspunten voor je pingpong, pool of FIFA skills.


Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een stagevergoeding;

  • Een moderne werkplek waar je alle middelen en tools krijgt om je werk als een pro uit te voeren;

  • De mogelijkheid om zowel thuis als op kantoor te werken;

  • Een toffe relaxruimte met o.a. pooltafel, tafeltennis en FIFA;

  • Een werkomgeving waar openness, drive en happiness centraal staan.

  • Geregeld leuke uitjes, teamdagen, sprekers en workshops;

  • Geen torenhoge hiërarchische lagen. Gewoon een platte organisatie.

jobs.description:
Deployment Strategist, AI Solutions

London, with travel to NYC and client sites

Who A.Team is?

A.Team builds the agentic operating system for the enterprise. Every company is being told AI will change how it works, and few are seeing it happen. We’re here to change that. We build AI systems that capture what a company knows as work happens, carry it across teams and decisions, and get smarter with every outcome. We pair them with top AI talent who embed with our customers to make sure those systems get adopted and keep improving. Today we’re focused on consumer packaged goods. Global CPG marketing teams use A.Team to act on cultural trends as they happen, optimize campaigns and media spend, and turn commercial and pricing signals into clear decisions. We’re proven in production with Fortune 500 brands and partner with Google Cloud, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced enterprise transformation and delivery leader to own the end-to-end success of one of A.Team's most strategic enterprise clients.

You will lead a complex, multi-workstream AI transformation program, working closely with senior client executives and A.Team's product, engineering, and delivery teams. Your responsibility is to translate business priorities into an actionable roadmap, drive execution across teams, ensure successful adoption, and deliver measurable business impact.

This is a highly visible leadership role that combines strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and executive relationship management. You will be the single point of accountability for the overall success of the client program—from defining priorities and aligning stakeholders to ensuring solutions are delivered, adopted, and generating value.

You'll work closely with the Account Executive, who owns the commercial relationship, renewals, and expansion, while you own delivery execution and client outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has successfully led large-scale enterprise transformation or technology implementation programs, can navigate complex organizations, and knows how to turn ambitious strategies into real-world results.

What You'll Do

  • Own End-to-End Client Delivery: Take full accountability for the successful delivery of a strategic enterprise client program, from defining priorities and planning through implementation, adoption, and measurable business impact. Ensure all workstreams deliver against agreed objectives, timelines, and quality standards.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Coordinate product, engineering, PMs, and AIOps teams to deliver as one integrated program. Set priorities, manage dependencies and risks, resolve escalations, and ensure clear ownership and accountability across teams.

  • Define and Drive the Deployment Roadmap: Work with client stakeholders to translate business objectives into a prioritized roadmap of AI use cases. Identify high-impact opportunities, validate them quickly with our Pathfinder team, and continuously evolve the roadmap based on business needs and results.

  • Ensure Successful Implementation: Oversee the deployment of AI solutions, from initial pilots through production rollout and ongoing operations. Proactively identify and remove blockers, manage delivery risks, and ensure solutions meet both business and technical requirements.

  • Drive Adoption and Change Management: Ensure deployed solutions become embedded in the client's day-to-day workflows. Work with business stakeholders to drive organizational alignment, overcome resistance, address training needs, and maximize adoption.

  • Deliver Measurable Business Value: Define success metrics and business cases for each initiative. Track performance, adoption, and ROI, ensuring the program delivers tangible business outcomes rather than simply shipping technology.

  • Lead Executive Stakeholder Relationships: Serve as the primary delivery counterpart to senior client executives. Build trusted relationships, align stakeholders across functions, manage expectations, lead executive reviews, and navigate complex organizational dynamics.

  • Partner with the Account Executive: Work closely with the AE, who owns the commercial relationship, renewals, and expansion. Surface new opportunities, provide evidence of delivered value, and ensure alignment between client priorities, delivery commitments, and commercial objectives.

  • Build a Scalable Delivery Playbook: Capture lessons learned, establish best practices, and develop repeatable processes that can be applied across future enterprise deployments.

Must-Haves

  • Enterprise Transformation Leadership: 8+ years of experience leading large-scale digital transformation, technology implementation, or innovation programs for major enterprises. You've owned complex programs from strategy through execution and delivered measurable business outcomes. Experience may come from management consulting, enterprise technology companies, or in-house transformation leadership. This is the most important requirement for the role.

  • End-to-End Program Ownership: Proven ability to lead complex, multi-workstream programs, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing competing priorities, resolving dependencies, and driving execution. You take full accountability for outcomes, even when teams don't report directly to you.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: A track record of building trusted relationships with senior enterprise executives, navigating complex organizations, aligning stakeholders with competing interests, and influencing decisions. You're equally comfortable in the boardroom and working hands-on with delivery teams.

  • AI and Technical Fluency: Strong understanding of how enterprise AI and technology solutions are designed, built, integrated, deployed, and operated. You can engage confidently with engineers and technical leaders, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and translate technical complexity into business implications. You don't need to be an engineer.

  • Business Acumen and Value Realization: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable plans, define meaningful success metrics, build compelling business cases, and demonstrate measurable value through adoption, operational improvements, and ROI.

  • Decisiveness and Problem-Solving: Strong judgment and a bias for action. You can navigate ambiguity, make difficult trade-offs, resolve complex problems, and keep teams focused on what matters most.

  • London-Based: Based in London, with the ability to work on-site with enterprise clients and travel to New York and other client locations as needed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • CPG, marketing or commercial-function experience

  • Experience driving adoption of AI or agentic tools inside large enterprises

  • Experience at an early-stage company where you built the playbook, not just ran it

  • Background spanning consulting and product or delivery leadership

jobs.title: (Senior) Strategic Partner Manager   (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

London, UK

Moss is building its strategic partnerships function from scratch, and this is one of the first two hires shaping it. You'll take target platforms from zero relationship to live, revenue-generating integration, owning the sourcing, business case, and delivery for each one.

This is a build phase: you'll define your own playbook rather than follow one. You'll report to the Senior Director Partnerships and work closely with Product and Engineering on integration scope, and with the Channel team where partnerships overlap with existing ERP integrators.

Your responsibilities

  • Source and build strategic partnerships from scratch, identifying platforms that fit Moss's customer base and growth priorities

  • Navigate complex partner organisations to reach the right decision makers, from founders and C-level contacts at smaller platforms to Heads of Partnerships at larger ones

  • Build the commercial and technical case for each partnership and secure buy-in from both Moss leadership and the partner's stakeholders

  • Own each partnership end-to-end, from an initial referral or lightweight integration through to a live, revenue-generating relationship

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to scope integration requirements and manage delivery against Moss's API and roadmap

  • Collaborate with the Channel team where accounting-platform integrators already exist, to avoid overlap and align on commercialisation

  • Define and adjust your own playbook, prioritising partners by revenue potential and strategic fit as the market picture sharpens

About you

  • 5+ years in business development or partnerships within B2B SaaS, fintech, cloud, or payments

  • At least 2 years specifically in strategic partnerships or integration-led partner roles, having built relationships from scratch rather than managed an existing book

  • Working knowledge of APIs and how software platforms integrate with external partner systems

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Thrives with full ownership of a plan and pipeline, without needing day-to-day direction

  • Brings structure to ambiguous, still-being-built processes and partnerships

  • Communicates progress, blockers, and trade-offs clearly across product, engineering, and leadership

  • Balances ambition with realism, adjusting timelines to partner readiness and internal constraints without losing momentum

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).
